name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan ripped out the heart of America
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Everywhere I go, I hear people asking the same question: Is our life any better after 17 years of Jim Jordan?
We used to be the industrial heart of America, powering this country with our manufacturing strength.
But under Jim Jordan’s reign in Congress, that heart has been ripped out and sold off.
Six factories in our district alone have shut down on his watch. Six.
That’s not just a number – those are thousands of jobs lost, pensions gone, retirements destroyed, and entire communities gutted.
I need your help to end this disaster. Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to make sure Jim Jordan can’t destroy us any longer? Every dollar helps us get our message out and bring hope back to everyday people. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241024_heart_of_america_link1]
Jordan likes to blame Democrats for everything, but the truth is, he’s the one who’s been sitting in that seat for 17 years while Ohio has suffered. While he’s busy chasing conspiracy theories and made-up enemies, our district has been hollowed out.
Foreign trade deals have wiped out our industries, and Jordan did nothing to stop it.
Jordan stood by as jobs disappeared, entire livelihoods gone, and yet he’s still more interested in playing ULTRA-MAGA political games than helping us rebuild.
Our children and grandchildren deserve better than a future of boarded-up factories and abandoned main streets.
We deserve a future where we are strong again – where we bring back good-paying jobs, restore our manufacturing power, and invest in the families and workers who make this state great.
I’m not just talking about nostalgia. We can do this, but it’s going to take a new kind of leadership – one that actually fights for us, not Trump or some Christian nationalist agenda no one’s asking for.
My team and I are pushing ourselves to the limit to make this happen, and that’s exactly how I’ll work for you in Congress.
This is the most important congressional race in the country. Everyone is feeling the change in the air – are you ready for it? We need you in this fight. Chip in $25, $50, or $100 today, and together, we will bring the heart of America back to life. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241024_heart_of_america_link2]
Let’s do this.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]

Why do opponents of voting rights keep trying to make it harder to vote? Why are they trying day after day to limit pathways for you to submit your ballot?
It's simple -- they know that their voters and supporters have no trouble taking time off or being late to work to go vote. They know that their voters have plenty of polling locations with short lines and barely any waiting. They know they can chip at the margins here and there and win elections by limiting drop boxes, closing polling locations in certain communities, and reducing early voting hours and availability.
RUSH $25 or more right now to fight back and make voting accessible for everyone, from Ohio to every other state in our country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102424_3&amount=25]
Ohio Capital Journal: Ohio Sec. of State LaRose proposes eliminating ballot drop boxes, changes rules ahead of election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_3&amount=25]
Drop boxes are threatened in Ohio by the very elected official whose job is to run the election, Team.
Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose has asked leaders in the Ohio state legislature to create a law eliminating ballot drop boxes even after a court ruled that people with disabilities should have more opportunities to vote.
LaRose also used his own powers as Secretary of State to add more steps before voters can use drop boxes ahead of the November election. His actions will disenfranchise millions of voters this fall : 1 in 4 Ohioans voted absentee in their last election, according to state data.
This hurts Ohio's voters, from working families to college students to the elderly. An Ohio state senator summed it up for everyone: “ They make it tougher for people to vote, make it tougher for people to take their own spouse’s ballot to the one box in the county that they’re allowed to have to drop off their ballots, anything they can do to make it tougher to vote. ”
Team: We MUST stand up to defend access to the ballot and increase voter participation in our elections. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help protect the use of mail-in ballots, drop boxes, and so many more ways to vote in Ohio and across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=102424_3&amount=25]

|

# Housing in this country is a problem
---
| Dear Peter,
---
| Housing in this country is a significant and pressing problem and one that I am willing to tackle if elected as your representative.
---
| With over 30 years of experience as an executive in the Housing Industry, I am uniquely qualified to openly discuss solutions to this issue and can effectively advocate for a comprehensive national housing solution to both increase the supply of affordable homes and lower overall costs, benefiting California and every state in our union.
---
|
## My vision includes the following solutions
---
[](https://ackramerforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0681592302c29e74ce410ea82&id=b3a5742928&e=d9ccafcb33)
|
* Market-Driven Housing Initiatives: I would propose a comprehensive nationwide approach that effectively leverages free-market principles.
* Fiscal Responsibility and Local Control: I believe in the responsible and judicious use of taxpayer funds and the importance of empowering local communities to make decisions that best suit their unique needs and circumstances.
* Free Market Solutions: To effectively address the alarming, inflated cost of living that many families are facing, I trust our free market to find solutions.

---
| My strategy fosters economic growth and innovation contributing to a stronger, more vibrant society. The benefits for Californians include community engagement and promoting sustainable development while ensuring that the diverse needs of its residents.
---

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Man pleads guilty to murder in fentanyl OD death in Tarrant County** ," Dallas Morning News' **Lana Ferguson** -- "Prosecutors secured the first conviction in Tarrant County under a new state law allowing defendants to be charged with murder in some [fentanyl](https://substack.com/redirect/6a4c6363-c206-4d36-9088-8b94991f17b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) overdose deaths, the district attorney's office announced Thursday.

**Kaeden Farish** of Azle pleaded guilty to murder Tuesday and was sentenced to 19 years in prison.

Farish, 19, sold fentanyl-laced pills on Jan 20. to a 17-year-old who overdosed and died.

"We are working hard to get the people who sell this poison off the streets," Tarrant County DA**Phil Sorrells** said in a news release.

The Texas law allowing someone to be charged with murder if they knowingly manufacture or distribute fentanyl that results in death was [adopted in June 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/a63541c6-1cfb-4b28-83d5-d84713654d02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). One of the [first convictions under the new law](https://substack.com/redirect/7232ab11-e2ac-48dd-93e0-c7d115306129?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was in September 2023 in Wichita County as reported on in _The Dallas Morning News_ ' award-winning project, [Deadly Fake](https://substack.com/redirect/99f1df90-bae0-4e24-8744-5c4ccdfc3a8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which documented fentanyl's impact on North Texas.

Last year, Sorrells created a new unit at the DA's office focusing on cases that involve narcotics -- fentanyl, heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine and more, according to the release.

* **TOP NEWS**

"**Man pleads guilty to murder in fentanyl OD death in Tarrant County** ," Dallas Morning News' **Lana Ferguson** -- "Prosecutors secured the first conviction in Tarrant County under a new state law allowing defendants to be charged with murder in some [fentanyl](https://substack.com/redirect/a5bde663-ad44-4211-86dd-bd9629bb4983?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) overdose deaths, the district attorney's office announced Thursday.

**Kaeden Farish** of Azle pleaded guilty to murder Tuesday and was sentenced to 19 years in prison.

Farish, 19, sold fentanyl-laced pills on Jan 20. to a 17-year-old who overdosed and died.

"We are working hard to get the people who sell this poison off the streets," Tarrant County DA**Phil Sorrells** said in a news release.

The Texas law allowing someone to be charged with murder if they knowingly manufacture or distribute fentanyl that results in death was [adopted in June 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/028ecd64-e101-439b-b2b1-86255b8407da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). One of the [first convictions under the new law](https://substack.com/redirect/7b0d23fa-137e-4812-af69-e478913e94e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was in September 2023 in Wichita County as reported on in _The Dallas Morning News_ ' award-winning project, [Deadly Fake](https://substack.com/redirect/704fecca-c037-4e17-a970-b33f76de9032?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which documented fentanyl's impact on North Texas.

Tarrant County's [first indictment tied to the law](https://substack.com/redirect/924b4e18-c604-406c-a004-6ef2fa00d9de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was in December 2023.

Last year, Sorrells created a new unit at the DA's office focusing on cases that involve narcotics -- fentanyl, heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine and more, according to the release.

"We are holding people accountable in Tarrant County," Sorrells said. "We are doing everything we can to keep our community safe. We will continue to go after those who seek to profit from this deadly drug. You make it or deal it to someone who dies, we'll charge you with murder."" | **BRADLEY: What's Stake on November 5th?** October 22, 2024
---
---
| |
---
| New Hampshire’s future is at stake in the upcoming election. I was proud to serve in the New Hampshire Senate from 2009 to 2024. Working with my colleagues, the House, and Gov. Sununu, we have strengthened New Hampshire’s Advantage over neighboring states. We lowered business taxes that were among the highest in the nation. What happened? Economic growth increased, generating far more revenue than anticipated. We phased out the Income Tax on Interest and Dividends. Over 60 percent of the people who file this tax return pay $500 or less. Despite the spin, this income tax targeted retirees and small business partnerships. We lowered the cost of workers’ compensation and unemployment compensation. We balanced our budgets and have deposited almost $300 million of surplus revenue into the Rainy Day Fund. We also used surplus revenue to make significant investments in our mental health and substance abuse prevention efforts. We further used surplus revenue to make significant increases in funding for public education and affordable housing. We dedicated significant revenue to making our public schools safer. We enhanced parent’s opportunities to send their children to alternative schools best suited for their needs, and we fought to make sure parents are fully informed of what is happening in their children’s schools. We fought efforts to curtail free speech rights guaranteed by the Constitution, and we preserved law-abiding citizens’ rights to protect their property and loved ones. We worked to ensure our elections are clean and transparent — that it is easy to vote but hard to cheat. We worked to upgrade our drinking water and wastewater systems and worked to diminish the threat of PFAS, often called forever chemicals. We worked to provide greater access to health care while at the same time protecting taxpayers. And we dedicated significant surplus revenue to property tax relief — $500 million in the 2021 budget and $169 million more for public education in 2023. What have the results of all this work been?
* New Hampshire is the safest state in the nation. (US News and World Reports)
* New Hampshire has the lowest poverty rate in the nation. (Census Bureau)
* New Hampshire has the 5th highest median family income in the nation. (World Population Review)
* New Hampshire has the 4th lowest unemployment rate in the nation (US Bureau of Labor Statistics)
* New Hampshire ranks first for Health and for Child Well Being (Annie E. Casey Foundation)
* New Hampshire ranks first for economic freedom (Fraser Institute)

What does this mean? US News and World Reports ranks New Hampshire as the 2nd Best State to live in! It also means Republicans have done their job of governing! Unfortunately, Democrats will change this dramatically if they win in November. Look no further than Democrats using abortion as a wedge to hide their true intentions. First, the facts. Abortion is safe and legal for any reason in the first 24 weeks of pregnancy. In the seventh, eighth, and ninth months, there are exceptions to protect a woman in a medical emergency and for fatal fetal anomalies. Those are the facts. That’s the law. And most New Hampshire residents agree abortion on demand in the seventh, eighth, and ninth months, even up until the moment of birth, is not acceptable except to protect the mother or fatal fetal anomalies. So, why are Democrats misrepresenting the facts on abortion? It’s simple. Democrats want to raise business taxes and restore the Income Tax on Interest and Dividends. Many Democrats want an even more broad-based income or sales tax. With groceries and energy costs out of sight, hard-working New Hampshire residents can’t afford an income or sales tax. Democrats support sanctuary policies — a magnet for illegal aliens to come to New Hampshire. Democrats opposed more law enforcement resources on New Hampshire’s northern border. New Hampshire voters need look no further than Massachusetts, where taxpayers are on the hook for over a billion dollars just for shelter services for illegal aliens. Many Democrats fought efforts to fix our bail laws so that violent criminals were too often released only to reoffend again. Many Democrats fought efforts to toughen penalties on drug traffickers who distribute fentanyl and other deadly drugs to New Hampshire residents. Democrats support policies that will drive up the cost of energy in New Hampshire when the cost of everything, including energy, has risen precipitously due to Washington’s inflationary policies. Democrats oppose efforts to ensure that women play in women’s sports and have women-only locker rooms. Democrats oppose efforts to ensure that parents know what is happening in their children’s schools and oppose educational choices for low-income families. We can continue on the path that has New Hampshire at the top of so many national rankings. Or we can choose a path like so many states around us of high taxes, less economic opportunity, more and more government spending, higher crime, more illegal aliens, and less freedom. For me, the choice is clear in New Hampshire. Vote for Republicans to stay in charge in Concord —- starting with Kelly Ayotte!

Peter, can I be totally honest here?
I wish I didn’t have to do this. If I could win this race without sending you another email, I’d do it in a heartbeat.
I wish I didn’t have to write to you after a long day and ask you to chip in because we’re behind on a goal, or because our race is tightening, or because Trump tore into me at another one of his rallies.
But that’s what happened today. Trump came back to Arizona, had a rally in Tempe, and pulled all his supporters behind Kari Lake again. He’s doing it because he knows he has to defeat me, has to tear me down, if he’s going to have a shot at winning in Arizona.
This campaign isn’t funded by a few millionaires and billionaires writing huge checks. The only way we can fight back at Trump when he does stuff like this is through supporters like you, chipping in what you can, when you can.
So, I’ve got to write to you. I’ve got to ask you. Because when a ton of folks come together and chip in at the same time, we can raise a ton of resources, really fast.
And at a moment like this, with Trump coming for us and time running out, that’s exactly what I need.

GREAT NEWS, folks: Another urgent fundraising message with your name on it! This one is from Jimmy Kimmel, the guy from late-night TV.
Look, I hate getting these messages, too. But I was just in Nevada campaigning for my good friend, Jacky Rosen, who is fighting to defend my home state and the Senate from GOP extremists – and I had to reach out to ask if you'll join me in supporting her.
So please, will you join me by splitting a $20 donation or more to Jacky's campaign and Tim Kaine now? Every dollar will help her defeat her Trump-obsessed opponent and continue fighting for you and your family in the Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]

Long before she was a senator, Jacky worked with my father as a computer programmer in a male-dominated field. Jacky is a smart, strong, and reasonable person who cares deeply about the hardworking people of Nevada and across our country.
Jacky is fighting to lower prescription drug costs, restore reproductive freedom, strengthen workers’ rights, and pass commonsense gun safety reforms. She's also trying to protect us from people like her MAGA opponent, who wants to be another destructive force in the Senate helping Republicans crush affordable health care, ban abortion, and do nothing about the senseless gun violence Nevadans know all too well.
We can do better for Nevada and our country than the lies, greed, and self-interest that Donald Trump and his spineless sycophants in the GOP have in store. Jacky is fighting in the Senate every day to build up this country, not tear it down. And she needs our help.
Recent polling shows her LOSING GROUND to her extreme MAGA opponent, Sam Brown – and she's running out of time to pull ahead before Election Day.
There is no time to waste, and Jacky is relying on grassroots supporters like you to fund her campaign. The only way she can fight back against the Republicans trying to buy her seat is with your support. So please: Will you join me and split $20 or more to help Jacky win her race in Nevada so Democrats can defend the Senate and White House and keep fighting for progress? body:
If this isn’t a wake-up call I don’t know what is
#

Peter, you read that correctly.
**Kari Lake filed her pre-general FEC report, and as of October 16th her campaign has more cash on hand than we do.**
If this isn’t a wake-up call I don’t know what is. It invites the worst kind of scrutiny — millions more dollars from outside spenders, fresh waves of attack ads — at the exact moment that we’re worst positioned to fight back.
Our fundraising hasn’t been where it should be all month. We tried continuously to turn it around, but nothing broke through. As a result, we’ve had to make some tough decisions.
And now, we’re seeing the effects. **We just got word that we’re being outspent in the Tucson media market. This is the second largest metropolitan area in the state, home to thousands of undecided voters.
Turning this around will not be easy, but it’s clear that we have no other option. We need all hands on deck. We have to dig deep now, or we risk everything we’ve fought for over the course of this entire campaign.

# **Voting Matters**
* * *
**__**
* * *
**WATCH: Senator Hughes shares how easy it is to vote NOW at[one of Philadelphia's satellite election offices](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11979). ** [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11980)
* * *
**Voting by Mail?**
* You must [apply for your mail-in ballot](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11981) by October 29th at 5PM
* The deadline to return your mail-in ballot is November 5th by 8PM
* Return your ballot as soon as possible to make sure it is received by November 5th
* You can return your mail-in ballot by mail or at a drop off location
* Philadelphia has drop box and satellite election offices where you can drop off your ballot. [You can find your closest drop off location online.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11982)
* If you need help finding a drop off location or have questions about your mail in ballot, call our office at 215-879-7777

**PRO-TIP: Utilize one of the city 's 10 satellite election offices to apply, complete, and return your mail-in ballot all at once. You can find a list of locations ****[HERE ONLINE](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11979)****.**
* * *
**Voting in Person on November 5th?**
* Figure out where you'll be voting before election day.
* You can [look up your polling place online](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11983) or call our office at 215-879-7777 if you need assistance
* Polls will be open on November 5th from 7AM to 8PM
* The busiest times to vote are in the morning and evening, so plan ahead or try going at a less busy time
* If this is your _**first time voting**_ , you must bring a photo or non-photo ID
* If you encounter any problems at the polls, call 1-877-868-3772. The PA Department of State will be able to answer your questions and help with any issues.

* * *
**Why Does Voting Matter?** **** Voting is your opportunity to let lawmakers at all levels of government know what you support, and don't support. While the Presidential race is getting lots of attention, there are a number of state and local races that could directly impact neighborhood issues that effect your day to day. Senator Hughes recently met with Reverend Jesse Jackson to talk about the importance of voting. They both agreed that there is no progress without engagement from the people, and that engagement starts with voting. [**Make your voice heard!**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11984) Follow us on [Twitter](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11985), [Facebook](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11970), [Instagram](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11972), and [TikTok](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168803.172382.206&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11973) for more from Senator Hughes!

It was as bad as I feared, team:

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: What do all these signs and symbols mean for you?
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Hello Friend,

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

When we all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will
be!

When we all see Jesus, we'll sing and shout the victory!

The words of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ's return
is going to be glorious!

But between now and then, how should we live? What does God's
Word say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful
... what should our response be?

When I have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of
Revelation, which I've found helps provide answers and strength
in these dark days.

And today, I'm pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of
the book of Revelation entitled Final Conquest.

Final Conquest is my first commentary on the book of
Revelation. It's all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most
hope-filled event in human history.

This book will help you face the future with confidence! God
doesn't want you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack
God's plan as never before - you'll be encouraged!

With your generous donation to Pathway to Victory-- to help
keep our ministry strong, for you and your family, and for
listeners and viewers across the country--I will send you a copy
of Final Conquest for free!

You can make your most generous donation here:
https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1

One day soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King
of kings and Lord of lords will return and make His final
conquest.

Until that moment, we are focusing our hope on Christ and
working together to proclaim the gospel and expand His coming
kingdom.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

# [Tell George Bush to end the silence, and endorse Kamala Harris](https://default.salsalabs.org/T97523344-d87a-4dec-82f5-64782a6ce880/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | George W. Bush is still very popular among Republicans, and his words and actions can still make a difference. But he's been essentially silent re: the election. [**He needs to end the silence now, endorse Kamala Harris, and tell other Republicans to join him in voting for her.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb0a8702b-28e3-40cb-91e6-0bafd670b338/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The hardcore Trump followers won't be swayed, but the remaining moderate Republicans (and those who voted for Haley and others in the 2024 primaries) might be. Could Bush convince a percent or two to switch? Most definitely. **And in a close election, that could make the difference. ** Huge numbers of prominent Republicans (including Bush's VP, Dick Cheney) have already done so, and Bush needs to as well. But time is short, and Bush needs to act now to make a difference. So he needs to decide -- will he put country over party? Tell him to do it. [**Tell George W. Bush to endorse Kamala Harris and encourage other Republicans to do the same**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T65894d7b-f207-4e8c-8664-aa406999f45e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-great-reset-cca/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d58f9074e7e4be6aeb1d87991837263&_e=TgvaLUwgHVAmNaMqPTKBORVz573F5i9cqPivbIC-QI3j95Y5t-Rgs74j0GTLbdWlXtiRtyfWkGJrM5wWyIwJjO9hFHlPlsEkUkv5teNzazoxKK_pSSniefLf0UUcEzYSSnxLTgD64Cu1cnY9p6aU_8N0X3PeRktvICZBtynpw2m8MIFMzwyYjju72L5XNV4VuSfYOqIWMPgfn7cRcHftM_uRCAlAYXzFFhusG6P0kfFvcaBT5ezPCW-pX7TMBYqpPADwXr4vuydzWnMcSX5htIHt118GuPPqVoBqPq2XUYp4JvgBwR2p9DRjfw27_zTilW80IHZHZX5l3vX67RyHtFJawoltdFtr2G59aW-0HtXZSjdjpVUw205T7CMQa0dMx-MYkfGgjg-d624Xp6KCnw%3D%3D)

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 10/25/2024
body:
Poll aggregators show Trump leading in battleground states, up big in “no toss up” map projection
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
We are in the FINAL COUNTDOWN. 11 days left, folks! Check out the [Election Day Dash](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to help us get across the finish line to save our beautiful state and country.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 25, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Poll aggregators show Trump leading in battleground states, up big in “no toss up” map projection](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
With a dozen days remaining until Election Day, the race for the White House between former President Donald Trump, a Republican, and Vice President Kamala Harris, a Democrat, could not be closer, according to three poll aggregators.
Harris holds a 0.2% edge in the national average at Real Clear Politics, but that is where the good news ends for her campaign. In the top battleground states of Arizona, Nevada, Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania, North Carolina and Georgia, Trump is leading the polls and overall has a 0.9% lead in top battleground states, Real Clear Politics projects.
Real Clear Politics presently gives Trump a four-point Electoral College edge, 219-215, with nine states placed into “toss up” category for an additional 104 Electoral College votes. In order to win the presidency, a candidate must earn 270 Electoral College votes. When Real Clear Politics forecasts the race without “toss ups”, meaning each state is assigned a winner, Trump presently has a 312-226 lead.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Never Surrender/America First rally in Fountain to feature ‘Mayor of MAGAville’, candidates for U.S, state seats**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 24** _Candidates in three U.S. House races and two Colorado House races will be among those speaking during the Never Surrender/America First Rally and Concert in Fountain, Colo._
__
[**Registered Republicans have returned about 28.3% of all ballots, Democrats about 31.9%**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 23** _The first daily release of returned ballot-count from the office of Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold indicates Democrats have a 3.6% edge over Republicans in ballots returned._
[**Decision ’24: Judicial retention on Colorado Court of Appeals**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | STATE | OCTOBER 19** _In addition to 14 amendments and statutory propositions appearing on ballots statewide and local ballot measures, voters are being asked to consider the retention of a number of state judges._
__
|
---
**[Mesa County to Secretary Griswold: ‘This is our community and our investigation’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mesa County Clerk Bobbie Gross announced an investigation into potential election fraud, urging Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold to let the county handle it locally.
* Griswold’s office released details to the media about the case, which Gross criticized, saying it could compromise the investigation’s integrity.
* Gross emphasized the importance of maintaining proper procedures, transparency, and accountability while avoiding premature disclosures.
* Mesa County requested public patience, committing to share more information responsibly as the investigation progresses.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Grand County passes resolution opposing Prop. 127, citing ecological, economic harms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Grand County passed a resolution opposing Proposition 127, which seeks to ban hunting of mountain lions, bobcats, and lynx, warning it could harm the local economy and wildlife management.
* County officials argue that hunting supports local businesses and provides a sustainable way to manage predator populations, which helps balance ecosystems.
* Commissioner Merrit Linke criticized "ballot-box biology," suggesting urban voters don’t understand rural needs and risks, such as predator control.
* Local wildlife professionals, like the Colorado Wildlife Employees Protective Association, support science-based wildlife management rather than emotion-driven policies like Prop. 127.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Overbeck: Don’t align with teachers’ unions against Amendment 80 for school choice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JOY OVERBECK, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_From the Strange Bedfellows Department: the Christian Homeschool Educators of Colorado (CHEC) have joined with the sworn enemies of school choice, including teachers unions, the National Education Association (NEA) the Colorado Educators Association (CEA), and the Colorado Democratic Party to work against School Choice (Amendment 80) on the ballot._
_For nearly 35 years, CHEC has championed parents’ school choice, helping families find Christian homeschool resources and comply with the state of Colorado’s homeschool laws. For far longer, the NEA, the CEA, and other groups working tirelessly against Amendment 80, like the American Civil Liberties Union, Americans United for Separation of Church and State, and even the Parent-Teachers Association, have tried to abolish parents’ rights and give government ultimate power over children’s education._
_Now comes a ballot measure that would finally lock into the Colorado Constitution the right to school choice for children in kindergarten through grade 12, and the right for parents to direct the education of their children – and the state’s preeminent homeschool supporters say, “no thanks!”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Barry& O’Reilly: Vote ‘NO’ on Prop. 131 and say you don’t want ranked-choice voting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JAMES BARRY & CHUCK O'REILLY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_With the passage of Proposition 131, the ranked-choice voting measure you may have heard about, petitions are the only way candidates will able to qualify for the ballot. Only candidates with big money supporting them will be able to pay canvassers enough money to stand in front of stores to get a sufficient number of voters to sign each candidate’s petition._
_That’s right! Only candidates with enough money supporting them will be able to pay canvassers. All candidates will need large amount of money to pay their way onto the ballot. As a result, those candidates are beholding to those donors._
_Why? Gone are the days when we gathered with our neighbors to discuss candidates at our caucuses and county assemblies to decide which candidate should appear on the ballot._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Pastor Bob: Don’t be an Adam. Be a Christ-like person and vote.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY REV. ROBERT BABCOX, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I find it odd that we have to beg people to fulfill their Christian, as well as civic, duty. Ever since Thomas Jefferson wrote to the Danbury Baptist Association in 1802, there has been a decline in Christians involving themselves in political decisions._
_For example, Christians all over the state of Colorado are upset because Amendment 79 is on the ballot, yet what have they done to convince anyone that it shouldn’t be? Up to 50% of evangelical Christians are either not registered or don’t even vote, and yet they complain about the results. If every self-admitting Christian voted, the outcome in this state would be far different._
_Oh, I know most (not all) politicians are slippery snakes, and you don’t want to be around them — I know I don’t. However, look what happened when Adam neglected his job to protect the garden and did not stomp [on] that snake. If we want to be rid of the snakes, we must be willing to get in the fight._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Aurora cover-up: Leaders downplayed Tren de Aragua gang threat while residents suffered](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | STATE | OCTOBER 24** _In recent months, Aurora has become the focus of growing concerns regarding the infiltration of Tren de Aragua, a notorious Venezuelan criminal gang. According to internal emails shared on Twitter/X from the Aurora Police Department, officers had knowledge of Tren de Aragua’s activities as early as September 2023._
__
[**Ganahl: Is the Pueblo mayor on a Republican revenge tour?**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 23** _Pueblo, Colorado, has become the backdrop for a politically charged controversy involving Republican Mayor Heather Graham and Pueblo conservatives._
[**Ganahl: Rinard the right choice for University of Colorado regent at-large**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY HEIDI GANAHL | STATE | OCTOBER 23** _The race for University of Colorado regent at-large in 2024 is shaping up to be a critical contest that will determine the future direction of the University of Colorado system._

name: Susan Wild
subject: why I’m reaching out today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Susan Wild for Congress

Hi Peter — With
Election Day less than two weeks away, I can only assume your inbox is
full of requests from campaigns like mine trying to earn your support.
That’s how my inbox looks!

Chances are, you didn’t wake up this morning thinking, “today’s the day
I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!” But I hope you’ll
give me a moment to explain why you should.

My Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, and right-wing super PACs have engaged
in a massive ad blitz to tear me down and flip my seat red — they’ve
already spent $80 million on the airwaves, and there’s more where that
came from.

A national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of
the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table if
Republicans flip this seat red. And trust me when I tell
you, Peter, they
sure think that they can.

It’s why Mitch McConnell’s super PAC just dropped $24 million worth of ads
in Wisconsin — they wouldn’t spend that kind of money this close to the
election unless they were confident Hovde could win.

With consecutive polls showing a tightening statistically-tied race and
elections experts downgrading our race to a “Toss Up,” it’s more urgent
than ever before that we respond to the Republican attacks I’m facing with
ads of our own to set the record straight.

But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same
luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my
megamillionaire opponent can. That’s why I’m counting on your grassroots
support today.

Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.
Donald Trump, if he is reelected with a Republican Congress, will be far more dangerous than we have ever seen before.
And if Elissa loses in Michigan, he will likely get that chance.
We have a responsibility to future generations to ensure that our republic survives. This is not just about the next four or six years—it’s about the kind of country we want to leave for our children and grandchildren.

— Decatur Tribune, October 15, 2024
“For years, Central Illinois has been leading the nation in groundbreaking agricultural research,” said Congresswoman Budzinski. “I’m thrilled to announce a $5 million federal grant for the University of Illinois to support a project that holds immense potential to revolutionize biomanufacturing. This funding builds on the $51 million federal dollars already heading to the iFAB Tech Hub and will further cement our region as America’s Silicorn Valley. I’m excited to see this project come to fruition and the potential it will unlock for Central Illinois and the global bioeconomy.”
PITCH IN TO PROTECT IL-13 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/njb-em-oct2024]
Team — Nikki has been a bipartisan leader in Congress since day one, and while most folks are more focused on the campaign trail, Nikki is still working to deliver resources across the 13th District.
This federal funding will help researchers develop more reliable biomanufacturing processes that can be scaled and support production of the growing bioeconomy including pharmaceuticals and biofuels.
Nikki is fighting every day to find solutions that not only help us innovate and develop, but allow us to invest back into the communities of Central and Southern Illinois.

body:
#

This is not the news we were hoping to share this late in the race.
We just learned that Kari Lake’s campaign has more cash on hand than ours going into these final eleven days. After weeks of missed goals, Kari Lake finally got the edge on us.
But that’s not all. We’ve also learned that Lake’s campaign and the outside groups and Super PACs backing her up have begun to outspend us in the Tucson media market. This is a must-win region of the state, and they are making their move to take it.
Lake’s Super PACs can spend virtually unlimited sums in this home stretch to take down our campaign. This is a huge problem. But the solution is the same as it always has been:
**We need you to chip in $5. Yes. Just $5.**
Now, your $5 vs. a wave of millions from Lake and the MAGA Right may not seem like a fair fight, and you are right. It’s not.
But when you chip in $5, and tens of thousands of other people add their $5 donation too, it begins to add up. And that’s how we’ll turn this around, hit our goals, and win this race.
So, we’re asking:
[**If you are able, will you make a $5 (or more, if you can) donation to our people-powered campaign before we lose any more ground to Kari Lake? **[To answer this question, Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on the history and current crisis in U.S. intelligence](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0997ede41e7a4ebc9a9f0a252b274545&_e=3TZbtryMsRBr-SnCQ_FC1apyr3JeTRrdydDx2i6vAPahUckatGHuK6nAwoRXFvX_eG8FrAVG8lQGAPAB_ZJU6r0O__hKVednGOQZpOBu6AIeA9Lx285c8Xoe4uQjFyM1hq3wHBvdaTMg8Szdr6FwRR7BEMfDbCIOgs2QdUCohBs8cW4QhyvAOoVUHOx9EooaW32GBpsYWnPjFRPOj6vW1HsWF9u013hu05THarFZanf72DXTWflXq0N7UCn0-IPA1g6-0k3dVMUi_4JfPF3fJw6lc9Yk-iGsiymXl4NJ-7RlvXF1y-6OhS-DKhY0AEYeBUvKX1e-qOPxPshR1KbRa_KA0xBZXjKWF-weJvqfPj4A2uBaN9YJu2ziOndEP1m-).**

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn why we need intelligence and how it is used against American citizens and duly elected leaders.

The CIA--originally founded as the OSS--was created in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor to help protect America from foreign threats. But in the last few decades, this notorious agency...
* FAILED to foresee the 9/11 attack and then took over a decade to find Osama Bin Ladin

* COVERED for the Obama administration after the assault on our embassy in Benghazi that led to four American deaths

* THREATENED the sovereignty of the American people with the Russia collusion hoax

* FAILED to warn Americans about COVID-19

* HID the origins of the Hunter Biden laptop and declared it Russian disinformation

America's Founders would not recognize this notorious intelligence agency.

We still need intelligence to help protect us from foreign threats. We needed it in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, and we need it even more today.

But now, the CIA serves its own interests...not those of the American people.

And so, it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is soon _not_ in power.

You might remember when New York Senator Chuck Schumer told MSNBC, **" Let me tell you, you take on the intelligence community, they have six ways from Sunday at getting back at you."**

Whether or not Schumer meant to make such a revealing statement, it is further evidence that you and I live in a country in which powerful government agencies do not operate according to the consent of the governed.

How did we get to this point? And how can we reform the CIA and our other intelligence agencies?

| | | | | | | | | |

|

| You may recall that in a message I sent in September, I referred to the militant Tren de Aragua gang from Venezuela that had taken over apartment complexes in Aurora Colorado. Since then, ABC reporter Martha Raddatz and others have dismissed the incident as being “overblown” because it was “only a few apartment buildings.” [https://hernandezforcongress.com/blog/are-you-safe-in-your-city](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=43a2546e61&e=638e6c2751)
While Americans were shocked in 2016 by MS-13 gang members who murdered two high school girls and hacked them into pieces in their Long Island neighborhood, Tren de Aragua is a more deadly organization. They are not a “gang” formed in a barrio. Tren de Aragua is a Venezuelan state-sponsored terrorist organization that has been sent to the US to destabilize our country. It is exactly like Iran sending HAMAS to destroy Israel. Listen to this interview of Joseph Humire of the Center for Secure Free Society.

---
| **His warning came too late for Laken Riley**
On February 22, 2024, Laken Riley, a 22-year-old Augusta University nursing student, was killed while she was jogging at the University of George in Athens, Georgia. In custody awaiting trial for Riley’s murder is Jose’ Antonio Ibarra, a Venezuelan who entered the US illegally and is a member of Tren de Aragua.
**Illegal Immigration is Now a National Security Issue!**
On March 7, 2024, the House of Representatives passed an immigration bill **H.R.7511 - Laken Riley Act** , requiring federal detention of migrants who commit burglary or theft. The vote on HR 7511 was 251–170 vote, with 37 Democratic members joining all Republican members in voting for the bill.
Then on May 22, 2024, the House passed**H.R.7909 - Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act** allowing for deportation of illegal aliens convicted of child abuse or physical or sexual abuse of women. The vote on HR 7909 was 266-158.

Clearly, Zoe is not concerned about National Security or protecting her constituents from violence.

As the clock ticks down to November 5th, the True the Vote team is working nonstop to support voters and election workers. Here’re a few updates on our ongoing efforts:

Tens of thousands of people have visited the [Scan. Check. Protect. page this election season to register to vote](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqFEwskBolcwDTncoK3F3O5Szg0eGEypOsGCWevlNIiXJfJg4rbuWuaMvhNpIEgfPcwyX5gKKvGMlIoXsrJDd7pKzzaBkszZar3XgsD8uYZsl/4aw/a8hsFQYZSbC3GtCQqTd0AQ/h2/h001.yt1UKAjD7D4yV9O_6s4vfQZ2tI_nEsCahJTyKm9zNFw), check their voter registration record, ensure inaccurate/outdated registrations are cancelled, and track ballots. name: Tucker Carlson
subject: Helpful video on the Electoral College
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs9RBiMWNS

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os9RBiMWNS

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has
become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of
this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths,
such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is
their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our
country-indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass
illegal immigration, we are racists.

This is a pivotal time in our nation's history-a time when we
must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens,
not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American
institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the
right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is Hillsdale College. And
today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support
in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious
liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of
education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free
government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its
teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication Imprimis,
its free online courses, and its tireless work to return
excellence-including excellent civics instruction-to American
K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept
one penny of government funding-not even indirectly through
federal or state student grants and loans.

That's why I ask you to take the time to view their video "The
Electoral College Explained" below and join Hillsdale in
defending freedom and the American way of life.

| | Peter, Early voting started today, and our campaign is feeling enthusiastic. Every member of the U.S. House of Representatives Leadership endorsed me because they know I have what it takes to win and **finally flip this seat RED.** But...I need your help NOW.

**My opponent is about to unload a massive ad buy with her last-ditch attempt to lie about me and smear my name. The latest attack is honestly sickening. Disgusting. 100% false.** She's pouring her own money into this final push. She's also getting money from fundraisers with Hillary Clinton and Hakeem Jeffries. We need to be able to push back, or we'll lose the momentum and lose the election.

**I need you to donate $20. Just $20.** I'm a small business owner. I'm not rich like April McClain-Delaney so I can't put hundreds of thousands into my campaign whenever I feel like it. I'm one of you. **[So I'm just asking you for $20 right now to help me counter my opponent's lies and contact more voters.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=11fc4a4c54&e=5a45ee1154)**

## Early Voting Surges Amid Tight Races
Over [28 million Americans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0ULGOwyAU-xrYiOCFQjow3JKtt94YvcCj5URCFVCi_P0p3W-zZcuW_fOYHphyWp_fuJBrsUwgQQslBdymgCmfk-bBRSKgnpNTFu6DATVo_nJkZhtQYQzG-3i3c8ABZbBB6oBRWp7claYk3FSvDECnDMYbSFB9MMbDwLSkkFrZut-S1vaimM-y09b5svDsXq29K-u_GIwMxuM4Oj_XlY566QzGCzIYCbd8ir20tD4FZfItlVV8hsAglpTzxWfMubQqPNYmahERNwYj31x4H5elGsu0fC6Y8qe-_XfH7uAvAAD__wtRYtg) have already cast their ballots for the 2024 election, with Georgia and North Carolina reporting record-breaking early voting numbers. Republicans are making up a larger share of early voters this year, notably in key battleground states such as North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Nevada. Recent [polls highlight the tight race](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGP4yAQBeBfgztbMMaYFBTX0OXaKy0wQzInYizDxfK_PxHtltt9xZunp_lzX-6OEm2P3-6Fpsa8AAfZC97DtARH6VpkF0xEBBw7NGKGm1YgtOyeRnvU2nvvb1HEKEXgUqkIQqHyko--I9PaBIdJjEIBDEK5OAEHMQalVtBMcgxU8zH8zbTVJ8Z05Tcew5pfXTLPWvfCxl8MLAN7nufwr7iag7tagIEtNR8XA7vhWRjYPSeqtDZiwrVS3prbCAZW8Oam_cBCAbdKLvXfyX7PKZX-U99_ncyTbgLOZwa2O0zYT0qJipqZ5I-Xo_SZWn963dvA_wAAAP__gE1thA) between Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump. A Wall Street Journal poll indicates Trump leading Harris 47% to 45%, while a CNBC survey shows Trump's advantage at 48% to 46%. Conversely, a Tipp Tracking Poll has Harris ahead at 50% to 47%.
## Restaurants Pull Onions in E. coli Outbreak
Health officials are investigating contaminated onions as the source of this week's McDonald's E. coli outbreak, leading some Taco Bell, Kentucky Fried Chicken, and Pizza Hut [outlets to remove onions ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O5CAQhJ8GZz2C9s_YAcElzvbSC0f8NDvcYNoCvJb36U-z-WUVVJX0fX8-Hh8mppg_f5uNdAv8QIkDKAk4PryJ6XoMndeBCKnvSKs7LvOEah66p57d3brFE_V4n5QMchycGkZrgkUjF99F_X5TEkfVqwnxpiYTRpSoej9NDmcxSPKxcbn95Zjbk0K6-IvKzfHWJf1sba-i_yVwFbie53nL1mU6Ly6vd0XgmumsAld71JipvuPGmS4otHNpAtfr2MAWk32F_UipAufIuUIovEGlRK5BM47BUkrwCg5M9rDH728Dz6NBYmfaz8KERgU25zmb5CsQOE4R-Gi2kHkJXMdFLfO4CFy7ov1-xpRine5ikJ-biemHqv3P8pfGfwEAAP__z_OCXg)from their products. The outbreak, linked to McDonald’s Quarter Pounder burgers, has resulted in one death and nearly 50 illnesses across ten states. Officials are focusing on [Taylor Farms, a McDonald's onion supplier](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFu7CAURL8Gd1hwwWAXFK9xt69Nad2F6zURhpUha-3fR06RLt1IZzQanY_bcsOYYn78x51cW8sCAjSXgsOwBIzpveguuJUISHXkpIVpNCBH3W1u8gNMYhqUMrgOVhOiFlppEuStuWMX3bUmBQxSSQPQy6sIAqQKxngYmRYUYitH_1libhut6V1edPS-7F1yW2vPytQ_BjOD-TzPPt99prNenMG8Eaa2_QZ-IQbzGpDvPpSMKVRO3JcUecmx5MpXPPbKa_k6PPHDZ5TWCmG7w4XnGVOK1VimxWPHmH5etL-svBx8BwAA__-NMmQ4), while the giant hamburger chain has pulled the popular Quarter Pounder from about one-fifth of its U.S. locations. McDonald’s is now facing [its first lawsuit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGStCAQhJ8GMywYAd2A4E_I9k8vtFCGXe7Q2UNcy7e_8vKL-gu6urv64z7efcppffz3C9oaaQQBikvBQY_Bp3yOqgk2IgJ2DVrZw20wIAfVPK2edAzQGT-LuUd5C0YN06R0lKpXIH2T7JUmBWjZSQPQSuOjBgGyC8bMMDAlMKRKpf2ktNYnxnzSG0s709Jk-6z1tbHuHwPHwB3H0e6brxT8eRkYuK1SORm4hVa8NBIFBu5qZeCkuPii7I9tT5XHlDHwZQ60-hw2jnymnDjtdSrov_j37kvFwl-0rwELA9frAYQZlBA9A9cUG15HyjltpmdKPBaf8u_Y-td5bws_AQAA___9wG66) related to the outbreak, and more cases are expected as the investigation continues.
## Yankees-Dodgers Ready to Battle Again
For the first time since 1981, and [a record 12th time overall](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOozAQxvGnMd0gewCHLVxcQ7fXXomMPZDZGBvZDihvf0r67T99-un_73v-thw4bn_tTqauaUaJPSgJOMzecnjNfePNSoTUNWTUDb9GjWrsm7uhtXeaOrd-ob9pK0e9SGW174dFkuxkw-b9piQOqlMasVXargNKVJ3X2uEoekmea8rtT-JY77SGVzopty7tTTD3Wo8iuj8CJ4HTdV2tW0o5Uq7lvRA47WEROEW6isDpQ79SDh4KZaYCSwoejkyeXeUUC6wpw8vGB1GBs4BPfqNcgKMLT89xg0zbxgQ_1j1KioAgwUYPFsozH5kLwX4eAqcmG39cHAIXfRO93HbL4cOuv2U8Df4PAAD__4BHdqI), the Los Angeles Dodgers and New York Yankees will meet in the World Series starting tonight, offering star power, rich history, and plenty of intrigue. Both the Yankees and Dodgers finished the regular season as the [best teams in their respective leagues](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j72O6yAQRp8Gd1gw_MQuKG7jLrfd0sIwTmYXmwhQUN5-lfRbf9J3zvm6rldPic7bf3-ga3teQYDmUnAwa_SUXqseotsRAdWATl5gnizISQ93J7xGGY0Bv6lZh0uYzSSi13PYQGtQA7n3mxRgpJIWYJTW7wYESBWtDTAxLTBSy2X8znS2O-7plZ9YxpCPIbl7a4_K1D8GC4Ol9z4eaXtvDJYTe2WwfHSPtPGeS4q8YiGs_FEwUmiUz8pf_vxBrDzmeMNSh-Lio1NKVO2FaXE7PKUPr_3V_3TwGwAA___8TlzD), marking only the fifth time in the Wild Card Era (since 1995) that both No. 1 seeds have reached the World Series, adding to the excitement of this year's matchup. name: Gabby Giffords
subject: The Lewiston, Maine community was forever changed a year ago today
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
The night of October 25, 2023 should have been a night for entertainment and camaraderie in Lewiston, Maine. Children were attending a youth night at a bowling alley. Innocent people, including many from the deaf or hard of hearing community, were playing cornhole and enjoying a meal at a local restaurant.
This night of fun turned into a night of terror when a gunman went on a shooting spree at both the bowling alley and restaurant. He killed 18 people and wounded 13 others in a matter of minutes.
My heart breaks for all those who were impacted by this tragedy last year. Families now have an empty seat at their dinner tables, and survivors must now live with the trauma of experiencing gun violence. The community of Lewiston is forever changed.
Gun violence is not inevitable. I believe in a future where we no longer experience tragedies like the one we witnessed in Lewiston. But to get to this safer future, we must demand that our elected officials take action and enact commonsense gun safety legislation, like universal background checks and extreme risk protection orders.
In less than two weeks, we have an opportunity to vote out gun lobby-backed politicians and elect leaders at all levels of government who will prioritize our safety and security. I hope you will join me in using your vote to elect leaders who will have the courage to act.
Thank you for standing with me in the work to build a safer future.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords
* * *

clean_body: One year of House chaos under Mike Johnson. | = Peter, Today marks one year since Mike Johnson took the Speaker's gavel, and what a year of dysfunction it's been. Under his leadership, the House has lurched from one crisis to another, putting partisan politics ahead of the needs of hard-working Americans. But here's what's even more concerning: Mariannette Miller-Meeks continues to align herself with the most extreme in her party – and that includes Speaker Johnson. In fact, Miller-Meeks and Johnson recently held a rally together in Iowa, further solidifying the bond between these two GOP extremists. It also shows the importance of this district and how much is on the line if he’s coming to rally support for her. = Photo by Robin Opsahl/Iowa Capital Dispatch = Johnson's time as Speaker has been marked by government shutdown threats, stalled legislation, and an inability to address pressing national issues. Even now, Johnson refuses to acknowledge the legitimacy of President Biden’s 2020 victory. Miller-Meeks' alignment with such extreme views is deeply troubling and dangerous for our democracy. And now the Congressional Leadership Fund (CLF), a Mike Johnson-aligned super PAC, has raised a staggering $81.4 million – and they're pouring millions of that cash into IA-01 to prop up Miller-Meeks. We need to fight back against this flood of special interest money. Christina Bohannan is the clear alternative. name: Jon Favreau
subject: We need to do everything we can to make sure Bob wins
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Jon Favreau here.
If you’re way too online like me, you’ve probably seen a ton of headlines about a bunch of rich guys running for Senate in states where they don't even live.
Connecticut mega-millionaire David McCormick is one of those rich guys, and he’s running against beloved Pennsylvania Senator, Bob Casey.
So look, this will be a _very_ close race, and we need to do everything we can to make sure Bob wins — [**which is why I’m asking if you’ll contribute $5 towards his campaign today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241025-2?refcode=em20241025-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4667_552475_gJ4TeP&akid=4667%2E552475%2EgJ4TeP)
David McCormick is a former Wall Street hedge-fund exec who wants you to think he grew up on a Pennsylvania farm, which is only true if you think that living in a mansion 10 minutes down the road from a farm where your family raised Arabian horses counts as “growing up on a farm.”
But wait, Peter, there's more: McCormick also thinks the most popular beer in Pennsylvania is called “YANG-ling,” which is like running for Senate in Massachusetts and saying you want coffee from "DOON-kin’ Donuts."
**If it wasn’t obvious before, it’s crystal clear now: David McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania.** But this will be one of the toughest races of the year for Democrats. McCormick has millions upon millions of dollars of his own to dump into this race, in addition to the backing of Donald Trump and billionaire-funded super PACs.
**Pennsylvania is as competitive as it gets, and with the Senate majority and the White House depending on it, we can’t take anything for granted.**
[**So please, will you chip in whatever you can to Bob’s campaign today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241025-2?refcode=em20241025-2&recurring=1&refcode2=4667_552475_gJ4TeP&akid=4667%2E552475%2EgJ4TeP)

body:

| | | Friend,

**We are flipping the District...and the Nation!**

I have been out at the polls speaking with voters every day since early voting began on Monday!

I had a particular conversation with a truck driver who has been a life-long Democrat. He hates Donald Trump and this is where I assumed our conversation would go sideways. It didn't. He continued on to say that his party has left him; he's not a communist and cannot get on board with what the Democrat party has become. They have left him. Needless to say, he went in and voted all the way down for Republicans and shared in my enthusiasm when he came back out.

UNITE AMERICA!

I will be stopping by Bayland, the Metropolitan Service Center on West Gray and perhaps one other voting location today in my rounds.

Get out and VOTE! And please contact your friends and neighbors and make sure THEY get out and vote! Polling locations are open every day now through November 1st and then expanded locations on November 5th.

God Bless You and may God Bless America!

GREAT NEWS, Peter! Another urgent fundraising message with your name on it! This one is from Jimmy Kimmel, the guy from late-night TV.
Look, I hate getting these messages too. **But I was just in Nevada campaigning for my good friend, Jacky Rosen, who is fighting to defend my home state and the Senate from GOP extremists – and I had to reach out to ask if you'll join me in supporting her.**
[**So please, will you join me by splitting a $5 donation or more to Jacky's campaign and Ruben Gallego now? Every dollar will help her defeat her Trump-obsessed opponent and continue fighting for you and your family in the Senate.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-rosen.0KQoJv&refcode=em241025-2-160&t=2&akid=3453%2E734936%2E7KPnrw)

We can do better for Nevada and our country than the lies, greed, and self-interest that Donald Trump and his spineless sycophants in the GOP have in store, Peter. Jacky is fighting in the Senate every day to build up this country, not tear it down. And she needs our help.
**Recent polling shows her LOSING GROUND to her extreme MAGA opponent, Sam Brown – and she's running out of time to pull ahead before Election Day.**
There is no time to waste, and Jacky is relying on grassroots supporters like you to fund her campaign. The only way she can fight back against the Republicans trying to buy her seat is with your support. **So please, Peter:** [**Will you join me and split $5 or more to help Jacky win her race in Nevada so Democrats can defend the Senate and White House and keep fighting for progress?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-rosen.0KQoJv&refcode=em241025-2-160&t=4&akid=3453%2E734936%2E7KPnrw)

Peter, As I'm sure you are aware, this is not a normal election. It is not a normal election when we are running against a convicted felon who wants to take us backwards. **But it's even worse than that.** Trump is undermining American democracy. Trump's goal is to destroy faith in American institutions and the rule of law and move us toward an authoritarian society. But it's not just Trump's dishonesty and authoritarianism that must be defeated. We cannot elect someone who believes that, in the year 2024, women do not have the right to control their own bodies. For the sake of our kids and future generations, we cannot elect someone who believes that climate change is a "hoax." This is why we must do everything we can to see that Trump is defeated and Kamala Harris is our next president. **[So please take a moment to sign up to volunteer in Pennsylvania. No one person can win in November alone -- not Kamala Harris, not Tim Walz, not any candidate running for office anywhere in the country. Winston

mystery, inside an enigma"-words that still ring true.

shifting balance of power in today's world-a better understanding
of Russia is critical.

Since
Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As
it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power,
its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own
history.

In the
Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet
Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of
world attention.

The need
for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of
its current importance and its long history as one of the world's
great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a FREE online
video series on Russia.

In our
online video series, based on a recent conference held at
Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian
history-including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine-with
special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of
the Soviet Union.

The video
series also explores Russia's significant contributions to
literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy-and
to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky
and Rachmaninoff.

You'll
also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic
relationship with the West today, and about the causes and
complications of the current Ukraine war.

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Day Of Prayer Tues. Oct. 29
body:
Take Time to Pray | |
---
| | | Thank you for your faithfulness supporting and voting for Harris and Walz. Evangelicals for Harris invites you to join us in a **national day of prayer on Tuesday October 29**. As people of faith, one of the most powerful things we can do at all times is turn to God in prayer, so we are asking everyone in our community to**pray on Tuesday October 29, and throughout the election.**

Devote some time and find your place to pray. Invite others to pray with you or pray on your own. Here are some suggestions of things you can pray for and ask others to pray for.
* That love for others, especially the less fortunate and the vulnerable, is what determines our votes;
* Wisdom for all voters to see what’s best for the country;
* That voters take their gift of citizenship seriously, producing a strong turnout;
* A decisive victory for Vice President Harris and Governor Walz;
* Protection and safety for all voters and poll workers;
* Respect for the integrity of the voting process and results, including concessions by those who lost;
* The prevention of any efforts to subvert or steal the election; and
* That the outcome can begin to bring healing to our country.

There may be other things you would want to pray for. We welcome your prayer requests [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=b5555befb9&e=43463f1dee).

**_Rejoice always. Pray continually. Give thanks in every situation because this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus._** (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18)

[**Vice President Harris prays every day, sometimes twice a day, to guide her work and focus on uplifting others.**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=54bdebde28&e=43463f1dee)

To support Vice President Harris, Governor Walz, and each other, we hope you will join us in prayer on Tuesday October 29 and every day through and beyond the election. We’re praying for you. Thank you!

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
October 25, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**ICYMI: Terra Lawson-Remer Caught Lying Again About Role on Homelessness Task Force**
Dear Friend,
It’s that time of the year – Terra Lawson Remer’s campaign is in full desperation mode gaslighting voters.
The latest from [San Diego News Desk](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=bf152baf2c&e=784f78234b), which reveals Lawson-Remer continues to lie about her work on homelessness while spreading misinformation on former Mayor Kevin Faulconer in mail pieces sent to voters.
The article highlights her failure to attend meetings as vice chair of the Continuum of Care Board within the Regional Task Force on Homelessness and effectively address the homelessness crisis in San Diego County, which has reached an all-time high.
Read the full article [here](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=33c96d7203&e=784f78234b).
[_**SD NEWS DESK: Terra Lawson-Remer Caught Lying Again About Role on Homelessness Task Force**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=714bcc42d8&e=784f78234b)
SAN DIEGO, CA — Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer has been exposed once again for misleading the public—this time about her involvement with the Regional Taskforce on Homelessness (RTFH). Despite public denials and previous claims that she was not a member of the Continuum of Care (CoC) Board, it has been confirmed that Lawson-Remer is, in fact, the vice chair of the board. Her absence from these meetings throughout her tenure has drawn sharp criticism, particularly as homelessness continues to rise across the county.
Adding to the controversy, Lawson-Remer’s name and position as vice chair appear in official records, revealing that she has not attended a single CoC Board meeting until recently. The timing of her sudden appearance—just weeks before the November election—has sparked accusations that the move is purely political. Critics argue that her absence reflects a troubling lack of seriousness in addressing the region’s homelessness crisis.
“She’s been lying to voters about her involvement on the board for years,” said one observer familiar with the board’s work. “For someone entrusted to tackle such a critical issue, it’s appalling that she not only failed to show up but also misled people about her responsibilities.”
---
| _(Terra Lawson-Remer’s mailer continues to show she’s not only lying, but now gaslighting the public about her role on the county’s homeless task force. She’s served as the Vice Chair of the Continuum of Care board since 2021.)_
---
| A mailer recently distributed to voters further highlights Lawson-Remer’s misleading statements. The mailer claims that Lawson-Remer has not been on the CoC Board—a statement now proven false. Voters are left questioning why the Supervisor failed to engage with the task force despite holding a key leadership position.
The Continuum of Care board plays a crucial role in shaping the region’s homelessness response, bringing together elected officials and service providers to coordinate funding and programs. As the county’s only representative on the board, Lawson-Remer had an opportunity to drive meaningful solutions but instead remained absent.
Lawson-Remer’s opponents have been quick to call out the discrepancy. “This isn’t just a broken promise—this is outright deception,” said a local resident. “Her failure to show up while homelessness worsened is embarrassing, and now she’s scrambling to cover it up because it’s election season.”
With homelessness becoming an increasingly urgent issue, the latest revelations have raised questions about Lawson-Remer’s leadership and priorities. Her absence from critical meetings has left many wondering whether she is fit to serve in a role that demands consistent action and accountability.

Friday, October 25, 2024 | Peter -- Earlier this week, we sent you a list of **9 ballot measures** up for vote this cycle. Today, we're highlighting **round two of this year's most important ballot measures!** The measures listed below span multiple states, initiatives, and parts of our system they're trying to amend.
### **This Year's Critical Ballot Initiatives, Round Two**
#### Statewide Initiatives
* **Arizona** \- Proposition 140 would open the state's primaries, ensure that all candidates have the same signature requirements, and change funding rules to ensure that taxpayer dollars are only spent on elections that everyone can vote in.
* **South Dakota** \- Amendment H would establish top-two open primaries in the state.
* **Montana** \- Ballot Issue 12 will create a top-four, open primary election in the state, with party designation being optional next to a candidate's name. The state is also offering Ballot Issue 13, which would require candidates to receive a _majority_ of the votes cast to win elections, likely resulting in something close to RCV being implemented.

And, another one that any reform-minded individual should be looking to _defeat_ :

* **Missouri** \- Amendment 7 would _BAN RCV_ in the state. Proponents have included it in an initiative where the first part would exclude noncitizens from voting (something that's already illegal), tagging on an RCV ban to the end of the bill to try to sneak that through.

**If these initiatives weren't enough** to get you fired up, we've got even more for you. On Monday night, Forward Party Co-Founder Andrew Yang joined John Opdycke, founder of Open Primaries, for the single largest virtual rally in support of open primaries _ever!_ You can watch the [video here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfb5GKCYMRerY4PRYoPRxILx&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=open_primaries_ballot_measures&n=2)! We just need to go out and make it happen. Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich.

**They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day.**

They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls.

Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum.

With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, _which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less._

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **
