name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Kamala Harris hates Christians . . .
body:
Dear Peter,

You may have heard the recent news about how Kamala Harris mocked pro-life Christian students for proclaiming “Jesus is King” during her rally at the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse (UWL) last Thursday.

But I promise you, it was much worse than what you’ve heard . . .

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/aQLyOobl5pvWJFXJ33zlrA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo_

Grant Beth – one of the pro-life UWL students who went into the lion's den to protest Kamala Harris for her abortion extremism – told Fox News just how radical Kamala’s crowd was at her rally.

"We got a lot of backlash. I was pushed by an elderly woman. We were heckled at, we were cursed at, we were mocked, and that's the biggest thing for me personally. In reflection of the event, Jesus was mocked.”

But it wasn’t just the crowd who attacked the students and mocked Jesus.

Luke Polaske – another pro-life UWL student who protested – exposed Kamala Harris for encouraging and even joining in the attacks from the stage.

"You can see on the video, she waves. She was actually waving to me. I took this cross off my neck that I wear and, as we were getting asked to leave, I held it up in the air and waved at her and pointed at her, and she looked directly in the eye, kind of gave me an evil smirk”

It was at that moment that Grant and Luke courageously proclaimed, “Christ is Lord! Jesus is King,” in defiance of Kamala and her minions’ attacks.

That was when the Vice President jeered, “You guys are at the wrong rally,” as the pro-abortion mob kicked Grant and Luke out.

Peter, this is what Kamala Harris and her pro-abortion pals think of Christians.

And it’s another reason for pro-lifers to make sure she doesn’t get ANYWHERE near the White House . . .

Or else, you and I are in for it.

If you agree, will you please consider making your most generous contribution towards Students for Life Action’s critical Election Year Programs
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/0JKSGpIB8HenBPf-MmrhPg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo_
?

It’s no secret that Kamala Harris is as rabidly anti-Christian as she is pro-abortion.

But now she’s openly telling Christians that we aren’t welcome, and signaling to the pro-abortion mob that it’s okay to attack us.

Grant Beth finished his Fox News interview with a stark warning to young voters and pro-life Christians, saying:

"[It's] imperative for young Americans and first-time voters like myself to understand that this is what you are going to get with a Kamala Harris presidency. You are going to get the Kamala Harris that alienates over 50% of the U.S. population that is Christian.

“You're going to get the Kamala Harris that skips the Al Smith Memorial Dinner that no major presidential candidate has skipped since, I believe, Walter Mondale in 1984... it just proves what type of person Kamala is and what type of leader she will be."

I couldn’t have said it better myself.

Vice President Kamala Harris is the most extreme, pro-abortion, and anti-Christian Presidential Candidate in US history – bar none . . .

And with less than TWO-WEEKS until Election Day, pro-life Christians must do everything in our power to keep her out of the Oval Office.

That’s why I’m asking if you’d please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 towards Students for Life Action’s Election Year Programs
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/XRnsq5BhXSxGdue6Md4Jiw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo_
.

Even $10 towards our efforts to stop Kamala Harris and her pro-abortion goons in their tracks will go a long way
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/w0ng2g9Zn6cKtmEotdsLtQ~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo_
.

Thank you for your generosity and for everything you do for Life, Peter.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

"We got a lot of backlash. I was pushed by an elderly woman. We were heckled at, we were cursed at, we were mocked, and that's the biggest thing for me personally. In reflection of the event, Jesus was mocked.” But it wasn’t just the crowd who attacked the students and mocked Jesus. Luke Polaske – another pro-life UWL student who protested – exposed Kamala Harris for encouraging and even joining in the attacks from the stage. "You can see on the video, she waves. She was actually waving to me. I took this cross off my neck that I wear and, as we were getting asked to leave, I held it up in the air and waved at her and pointed at her, and she looked directly in the eye, kind of gave me an evil smirk” It was at that moment that Grant and Luke courageously proclaimed, “Christ is Lord! Jesus is King,” in defiance of Kamala and her minions’ attacks. That was when the Vice President jeered, “You guys are at the wrong rally,” as the pro-abortion mob kicked Grant and Luke out. Peter, this is what Kamala Harris and her pro-abortion pals think of Christians. And it’s another reason for pro-lifers to make sure she doesn’t get ANYWHERE near the White House . . . Or else, you and I are in for it. If you agree, will you please consider making your most generous contribution towards Students for Life Action’s critical Election Year Programs ? It’s no secret that Kamala Harris is as rabidly anti-Christian as she is pro-abortion. But now she’s openly telling Christians that we aren’t welcome, and signaling to the pro-abortion mob that it’s okay to attack us. Grant Beth finished his Fox News interview with a stark warning to young voters and pro-life Christians, saying: "[It's] imperative for young Americans and first-time voters like myself to understand that this is what you are going to get with a Kamala Harris presidency. You are going to get the Kamala Harris that alienates over 50% of the U.S. population that is Christian. “You're going to get the Kamala Harris that skips the Al Smith Memorial Dinner that no major presidential candidate has skipped since, I believe, Walter Mondale in 1984... it just proves what type of person Kamala is and what type of leader she will be." I couldn’t have said it better myself. Vice President Kamala Harris is the most extreme, pro-abortion, and anti-Christian Presidential Candidate in US history – bar none . . . And with less than TWO-WEEKS until Election Day, pro-life Christians must do everything in our power to keep her out of the Oval Office. That’s why I’m asking if you’d please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 towards Students for Life Action’s Election Year Programs . Even $10 towards our efforts to stop Kamala Harris and her pro-abortion goons in their tracks will go a long way . Thank you for your generosity and for everything you do for Life, Peter. | | **For Immediate Release: October 25th, 2024
Contact: James Kyrkanides, Campaign Manager
Email: press@wesleyfortexas.com**
**For Release: Congressman Wesley Hunt Issues Statement Condemning VP Harris's Campaign Stop in Houston, TX Today**
**Houston, TX -** Vice President Kamala Harris is visiting Houston, Texas today to campaign for late-term and post-birth abortion alongside Congressman Colin Allred. She should, however, be coming to Texas to address the crisis at our southern border. In the 3.5 years she's been Vice President, Kamala Harris has let in over 15 million illegal immigrants, including over 13,000 murderers and rapists that have wreaked havoc on our Texas communities.

_"Kamala Harris is coming to Houston this Friday to hold a rally for her failing, anti-American presidential campaign. As a proud Houston native, I speak for many friends and neighbors when I say: she’s not welcome.

"As Border Czar, a job the very president tasked with her she’s now replacing in this campaign, Harris allowed millions of illegal aliens—including human traffickers, gang members, murderers, and rapists—into our country. This failure has directly endangered Houstonians, leaving us vulnerable to violent criminals.

"Her negligence as Border Czar contributed to the tragic deaths of Americans, including Jocelyn Nungaray, who was killed by two illegal aliens from Venezuela. Young women like Laken Riley, Jocelyn Nungaray, and Rachel Morin would be alive today if Kamala Harris had taken her responsibilities seriously.

"Kamala Harris’ leadership has brought death and destruction to our communities. This upcoming holiday season, countless American families will mourn an empty chair at their tables because she allowed violence to spread across our nation.

"Texans, Houstonians, and Americans will never forgive or forget Harris’ cowardice. If she were serious about securing the border, she’d urge the president she replaced to pressure Chuck Schumer to take up the Secure the Border Act, passed by House Republicans nearly two years ago._
_She’s in office now. _ _She can act today. _ _But will she? _ _Of course, she won’t.

"In less than two weeks, the American people will choose real change in this election by making Donald J. Trump the 47th President of the United States. Watch how quickly the problems in this country Harris can’t solve are solved by President Trump."_ ###

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

Peter.

#### "I think there should be a freedom caucus in every state...for the very first time, there are groups of people, not only in Washington, but in our state houses that are actually standing and doing what they said they would do. If we abandon them now, we deserve what we get. These people are brave enough to stand. We must support them."
#### \- **Glenn Beck**
* * *
Friends,
State Freedom Caucuses are incredibly successful - first and foremost - because they are strong freedom-loving people who effectively work together for our shared conservative values. But a big part of that is their ability to form coalitions and partnerships with like-minded organizations.
Our Louisiana Freedom Caucus [was instrumental](https://substack.com/redirect/f0ccb70d-6459-4151-b1eb-75f561fb66b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is helping **PragerU** introduce their curriculum in Louisiana public schools.
**America First Legal** and the **Alliance for Defending Freedom** have provided excellent legal assistance for our states. AFL [filed a lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/4f242e70-0fbb-4e32-b19e-55273b284980?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and won) on behalf of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus. Both organizations have assisted our states - like the Louisiana Freedom Caucus - in drafting bills. This is absolutely critical because most lawmakers rely on committee staff and legislative counsel to draft bills - but they often draft them in a way that sabotages the freedom caucuses' efforts.
On several occasions, State Freedom Caucuses have enlisted the help of the **American Accountability Foundation** , which provides critical opposition research into what woke agencies are doing behind the taxpayers' back.
Our states have also worked extensively with **Do No Harm** , which recently released [a report](https://substack.com/redirect/1344c712-8c7c-45e9-b669-51acf5e39b96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on how expansive and dangerous the practice of transgender surgeries for minors is in our country. Each freedom caucus promoted the report and highlighted the its horrific statistics regarding their respective states.
Likewise, **Riley Gaines** has been [a fantastic partner](https://substack.com/redirect/2d2728b8-9f9f-4514-9b34-972e4179e723?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the Network, working with our states on issues like keeping boys out of girls' sports and fighting the woke transgender surgery agenda.
* * *
#### **" The work that the State Freedom Caucus Network is doing in the different states is remarkable. There is no one who is fighting harder for our freedoms."**
#### \- **Riley Gaines**
* * *
The **Conservative Partnership Institute** has been a critical ally for the Network, helping our states by hosting educational training sessions and connecting them with national thought leaders.
When it comes to messaging and working with the media, our states have great relationships with state and local conservative radio shows. Our Missouri state director - Tim Jones - even has his [own radio show](https://substack.com/redirect/de50e672-41e3-4923-9217-460dc63f0c5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in St. Louis where he promotes the success of the local Missouri Freedom Caucus and the nearby Illinois Freedom Caucus. And The Blaze, led by the amazing **Glenn Beck** and **Daniel Horowitz** , has constantly amplified our efforts since we launched in 2021.
These are just a few examples, but the best part is that our coalition efforts are only getting **bigger and stronger**. There are countless national and state think tanks that have assisted state freedom caucuses. And the number of grassroots groups and activists is constantly growing because they have come to trust and support the "Freedom Caucus" brand and our shared mission.
* * *
#### "I'm convinced now more than ever that if we're going to save this country, it has to happen at the state level. And I think the State Freedom Caucus Network is leading the charge to make that a reality."
#### \- **Former Senator Jim DeMint, CPI Chairman**
* * *
**Bottom line: The State Freedom Caucus Network will continue to expand into new states, but at the same time, the current states are organically expanding their own reach because of our great allies and partners. It 's an integral part of our success.**

**Andy Roth**

body:
Facebook is implementing a restriction period from October 29th to Election Day, blocking all new political ads.

Peter,
Facebook is implementing a restriction period from October 29th to Election Day, blocking all new political ads. This is a serious obstacle to our mission of electing young progressives and mobilizing young voters, but there’s something we can do about it.
First, let me be clear: **this restriction is absurd.** It won't stop misinformation – it'll just make it harder for grassroots movements like ours to mobilize voters when it matters most.
But to keep up our momentum going into Election Day, we need your help right now before Facebook's restrictions kick in. **[If you’re in a position to do so today, please make a donation to my organization to help turn out young voters in November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241025?refcode=em20241025-1357&amount=5&refcode2=1357_587540_ak-ujK&akid=1357%2E587540%2Eak-ujK)**

This election could really transform our political system into one that works for everyday people. But we can't do it alone, especially with these new restrictions.
Leaders We Deserve doesn't take money from large corporations – we rely entirely on grassroots support from people like you who believe in a better future.
We have until October 29th to get our online ads out there. After that, Facebook shuts us down. But if we act now, we can create a wave of momentum that carries us through Election Day.
Let's flood Facebook with our message before they can stop us. Let's support young progressives on the ballot, turn out young voters, and build a country that works for all of us – not just the wealthy few.
Because when young progressives run, democracy wins. And with your help, we will win – Facebook restrictions be damned. **[If you’re with me, chip in today at the link below.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241025?refcode=em20241025-1357&amount=5&refcode2=1357_587540_ak-ujK&akid=1357%2E587540%2Eak-ujK)**

**David Hogg**

| | | | Friends, Election Day is right around the corner, and with that comes an intensification of the political division that has our country in a stranglehold. Amidst all the partisan bickering, many exhausted Americans are asking the question: What can we do to make a difference?

The answer is a lot simpler than you may think...

“Take a day, work the polls,” said Rye Barcott, co-founder and CEO of [With Honor ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ec0673a04a&e=33f53a5b1a)in a [recently published Op-Ed](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=1a92732ad8&e=33f53a5b1a) written in conjunction with Power the Polls, a nonprofit organization that recruits and trains poll workers across the country. Rye spoke about the organization and the importance of poll workers in a recent episode of the 13th and Park podcast. Listen below:
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=22193aa58d&e=33f53a5b1a)

| At a time when polarization is gripping the nation, volunteering as a poll worker can be a helpful reminder that democracy still works. We live in the greatest country in the world, and we should be grateful for the opportunity to participate in free and fair elections. As less than 2% of Americans today serve, either in a military capacity or national service role, working the polls is a different way to give back to your community.

So this November, take a day, work the polls and encourage your friends and family to do the same. Talk to your neighbors, even those you may disagree with on political issues, we can all agree to protect our elections. For more information on Power to the Polls you can visit [this link here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2eb403b935&e=33f53a5b1a).

Thank you for supporting our mission to reduce polarization in Congress through principled veteran leadership. If you want to learn more, go to withhonor.org.

Dear Fellow American,

Is it possible to repair the CIA?

To answer this question, Hillsdale College has created a FREE online video series on the history and current crisis in U.S. intelligence.

In this online video series, filmed during a conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn why we need intelligence and how it is used against American citizens and duly elected leaders.

The CIA-originally founded as the OSS-was created in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor to help protect America from foreign threats. But in the last few decades, this notorious agency…

FAILED to foresee the 9/11 attack and then took over a decade to find Osama Bin Ladin

COVERED for the Obama administration after the assault on our embassy in Benghazi that led to four American deaths

THREATENED the sovereignty of the American people with the Russia collusion hoax

FAILED to warn Americans about COVID-19

HID the origins of the Hunter Biden laptop and declared it Russian disinformation

America's Founders would not recognize this notorious intelligence agency.

We still need intelligence to help protect us from foreign threats. We needed it in the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, and we need it even more today.

But now, the CIA serves its own interests…not those of the American people.

And so, it's no surprise that anyone in power who goes after the CIA is soon not in power.

You might remember when New York Senator Chuck Schumer told MSNBC, "Let me tell you, you take on the intelligence community, they have six ways from Sunday at getting back at you."

Whether or not Schumer meant to make such a revealing statement, it is further evidence that you and I live in a country in which powerful government agencies do not operate according to the consent of the governed.

How did we get to this point? And how can we reform the CIA and our other intelligence agencies?

I invite you to learn more about this critical topic through our free video series, U.S. Intelligence: History and Controversies.

Larry P. Arnn

# Hello Peter!
---
|
This is it, only 12 days left until Election Day! All registered voters should have received their ballots in the mail by now, if you didn’t receive yours or want to check the status of your ballot, head to the Secretary of State’s My Vote [website](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=65b7d2c615&e=9659e2eb5e).
If you haven’t already voted, fill out your ballot and return it ASAP! By voting early, you’ll make sure your ballot is received on time by the county elections office and it allows our campaign to focus on turning out the remaining supporters who need a little extra nudge to vote in one of the most important elections of our lives.
In this final stretch, our goal is to knock on as many doors as possible and we can’t do that without the support of folks like you. We have so many opportunities to volunteer and I look forward to joining you all at many of these events as we Get Out the Vote!
Sign up below and I hope to see you out there!
---
|
---
|
# Volunteer Opportunities
We have several exciting volunteer opportunities coming up, and we would love for you to be a part of them. Whether you have a few hours to spare or can commit to helping on a weekly basis, your help is invaluable to us!
**Canvasses** Help engage voters for the 2024 election through direct conversations about what is at stake this election. This is a great way to engage with your local community and spread our campiagn’s message.

| **Message from the Congresswoman**
---
|
It has been the honor of my lifetime to serve as your Representative in Congress. Last week, I was thrilled to announce with Oregon Senators, Jeff Merkley and Ron Wyden that the Port of Coos Bay received $25 million in federal funding. This critical investment will help us move the Pacific Coast Intermodal Port Project forward at the Port of Coos Bay, which will bring over 8,000 jobs to our southern coast, cut greenhouse gas emissions, and strengthen Oregon’s economy. The work is not over and I look forward to continuing fighting for this project and other important investments in the future of our state.
I also wanted to make sure you saw our new TV ad, which showcases the support of firefighters, union members, and community leaders. As the Eugene Weekly Editorial Board said in their endorsement, Oregon needs a “tiger” in Congress. With your support over these next 12 days, I will continue fighting for our district!
Sincerely,

Larsen to do exactly that. Reproductive Freedom for All is proud to endorse him for reelection, and our members look forward to mobilizing to send him back to Congress this November."_ _— Mini Timmaraju, President and CEO of Reproductive Freedom for All_ In 2022, I was outraged by the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. This backward ruling struck a blow to our basic constitutional rights of liberty, privacy, and equality – which is why the American people overwhelmingly oppose the decision. **Two important pieces of legislation could restore reproductive freedom across this country: the Women's Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act.** The first would create a statutory right for health care providers to provide abortion care, and for patients to receive care, regardless of state attempts to forbid care; and the second would ensure that no one could prevent, restrict, impede, or retaliate against a person traveling to another state to have lawful abortion care. **These pieces of legislation passed with narrow margins in the House (219 to 210, and 223 to 205, respectively) illustrating just how important it is that we take back the House in two weeks and elect reproductive freedom champions.** Since then, Senate Republicans blocked the Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act and the Chaos Caucus' attempts to undermine reproductive rights have accelerated. But, as a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will fight hard to codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. **Organizations like Reproductive Freedom for All are on the frontlines of this work, and I am proud to stand with them.** The stakes are high this November, and we need to win to make sure we can make _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land. _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to Rick Larsen instantly:

These pieces of legislation passed with narrow margins in the House (219 to 210, and 223 to 205, respectively) illustrating just how important it is that we take back the House in two weeks and elect reproductive freedom champions. Since then, Senate Republicans blocked the Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act and the Chaos Caucus' attempts to undermine reproductive rights have accelerated. But, as a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will fight hard to codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. Organizations like Reproductive Freedom for All are on the frontlines of this work, and I am proud to stand with them. The stakes are high this November, and we need to win to make sure we can make Roe v. Wade the law of the land. Hi there, it’s Jay Jones. Can you believe that Election Day is almost here?
My team is so excited to vote in the most important election of our lifetimes. But the bigger question is: do you have a plan to vote?
Whether you’re voting early, by mail, or in person, it is imperative that we all make our voices heard this fall. Our elections have major consequences on the future of our city, state, and national government, so we hope you’ll exercise your rights at the ballot box.
For information about your voter registration and polling location, go to the Virginia Department of Elections Website: [https://www.elections.virginia.gov/]

Early voting here in Virginia ends on Saturday, November 2nd.
Make your voices heard, and we hope you’ll make a plan to vote on or before November 5.

Jay

Hi, it's Brian King and Rebekah Cummings reaching out, and frankly, we have some problems in Utah. **As a legislator,** I've seen an increase in extremism in our government and a hard shift towards Trump's style of politics, where hatred, partisanship, and fear-mongering drown out common sense. **As a librarian,** I've seen schools politicized for personal gain, and in the case of vouchers, **_greed._** **As Utahns,** we've both seen how unaffordable housing is, how wages have stagnated, how the energy industry's wishes have been put over our environment, and how the most extreme voices in the Republican Supermajority have been enabled by Gov. Cox. **_There's one common link in all of these issues, and by endorsing Donald Trump and campaigning with him in California, he's actively making things worse—Gov. Cox is that link._** **We're now just 11 days out from election day, and this last week and a half will be one of the most important moments of our campaign.** [**Rebekah and I don't have connections to corporations or wealthy donors like Gov. Cox does—we count on people like you to support our campaign. Please, before November, can you help us raise $15,000 online to keep our ads on the air and our teams reaching out to voters? We're within striking distance, and we need your support. Can you pitch in what you can today?**](https://king4ut.us/l/a9rIISsvB7wq)
---
[ DONATE TODAY >> ](https://king4ut.us/l/3aJp4Kzb2UxE)
---
For the better, Brian and Rebekah
---
|
---
We'd hate to see you go, but to unsubscribe from future communications, [please click here.](https://king4ut.us/l/4IgnKUgLwLBD)
---
| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/2hKlB7dmI5ZX)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

**Brian for Utah**
P.O. Box 581557
Salt Lake City, UT 84158
---
[ SUPPORT BRIAN >> ](https://king4ut.us/l/R6YnuicB79wt)

# [Tell the Washington Post to publish its endorsement of Kamala Harris, not cower to Jeff Bezos or Trump](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6f4118f0-9308-4569-a3bd-396c82e58952/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | The Washington Post announced that it will break with decades of tradition, and [NOT endorse](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb5578239-1c09-4879-93b8-6a62a36c0100/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) a candidate for president. Are you ****ing kidding me? Just days before the most important election of our lifetime, and one of the most influential papers in the nation decides to sit it out? Making matters worse, the Post apparently had an endorsement of Harris written and ready to go, but it was [blocked by owner Jeff Bezos](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1704c646-e0e5-4efc-88fa-d8e117b61b99/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) (yes, from Amazon), reportedly out of concern how Amazon would be treated by a Trump administration if it backed Harris now. This is outrageous on so many levels. The Post (and Bezos) has apparently decided that saving democracy and preventing the election of a guy who has a Hitler fetish is less important than the bottom line. This is the kind of thing that the Post should be willing to fight on, even if it means its demise. [**Add your name, and Tell the Washington Post to publish its endorsement of Kamala Harris, and not cower to Jeff Bezos or Trump**.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tac3bcea5-cfb2-4a6a-8130-a7e433cc6977/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Hola, Peter. It’s Ruben. You might be wondering how this kid...
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive races in the entire country.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because that’s all we could afford.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the country that gave me so much.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us “Lucky Lima”, but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends over there.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after Trump himself.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.
When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to defend our democracy at home.
When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.
And I never, ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you, people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.
I need you to do a bit more.
**[Please — if you can afford to make a split donation of $10 or anything you can to my campaign and Lucas Kunce, it would mean the world. November 5 is right around the corner, and we’ve got a ton of progress to make on our goals between now and then.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80271?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80270?refcode=em20241025-8225&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=8225%2E614464%2EkqpUZJ)
---
Thank you. I couldn’t do this without you and the team we’ve built together.
Semper Fi,
Ruben

Friend, I’ve held many titles throughout my life - including Governor and Senator - but neither of those matter to me as much as these two: **Dad** and **Grandpa**.

As a father of two and a grandfather of seven, my greatest responsibility is fighting for the future of our children and grandchildren. Every day in Washington, I go to battle to ensure the America they inherit is strong, prosperous, and free from the dangerous liberal agenda that seeks to indoctrinate them with radical values. I don’t just fight for my own family—I fight for yours, too.

But now, a radical liberal is working to unseat me and turn America into something we won't recognize. They want to tear down the values we hold dear and impose a socialist, big-government agenda that would weaken our nation and indoctrinate our kids. This fight isn’t just about me—it’s about defending the future for every family in America.

I won’t back down from this battle, but I need your help. My final end-of-month fundraising deadline is approaching fast, and we’re way behind pace. Meanwhile, my radical opponent is posting 8 figure fundraising hauls. So today, I’m humbly asking if you’ll contribute to my campaign and help me fight back to continue my battle for the future of America.

subject: The dishonor that I felt
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” | [](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSNwFqQY_hjU-vVcb5QHEi-byRDgYYqL5C4EzpmsAbXgvwuEiD-72O0HnC2wt0vV5Eax7P9buO-AnaMZsqFwrPePO0ucbWuugZUKqz__omxdh4do5X_sD6m9MsUT-LGSfjxVfWM4ERcKsRzgRJx6sbvI%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSPiUEBK1w4VIpp0c3LIUFSiFlaTV5IvXIkW4awhQ7pE4J_lNQO9feFeHL_Kax7c7ZE4QLTu6dtxWJ2e8gjXwCZCR0yLcveYNmiirhbG_62Ed5fuiOft6OHfE_DYaiEfD-yjswk-Rl9ZDoTsLbE4-gzQ%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSAR665HZxfhXLbwkJ5FhGZV-Fj3gXZ8E_urxOp6fr-1Zu_5tSv9Uzmg-bI4Yytn1lNHgU0uOJgKBI0QAKoSFaBUYI54Eh_LlvdrFoLlKsD1d0LODoj1ZKJT38u7QM3CsfUHq7oFKmyG0Mby7dU9fKcE%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSNfqCjmLi0c6WQb3ZHiRfCfa_9XKRr4vsbt8d2uk7JGiP5XAup1LPrlzv1knFhqe3kwurhOpCe7sb8frl6FouB4LlvQGl-gvGxcQobI2p1wdHiQ8NURWumda31r3Una0du-hQgGB6d3Q66hebN97Sq8%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSCYk0_xf10XF2mDZaW5iYZHPY_JDKrZEDT5_twm9N01AnpTR0xAUu4d7DNZiNhZdov7JUfymNKWIvr66uh5ZLgx_mh3-n2KDJ22Fd7u7slpdSfh5k6JgHhhIRRjJT7Xh_WzzMVht6MI6-pctfawmmHE%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSNY1utsDRPpocWj3xDreCenbGJd6fAicBGxSAR2jjrFm56subILWmNBfetsVltuOqVeVp4Cfuvt2uNZXUQy7e8VPqi7zJMxm5AXWdwbqighbMDQDqaUrCqYx068lfTjljjm6_VREej_kbvBO3wurY-U%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSDbUDpbqYG7HB43Nw0lkzYlNLb6cIu_O97Mlre2yJl6BjiTcktnh-KPoi7pL_7INm17MSYML5pT8l5CZi607rEtV1czHc5AyQ75pmp6HtB2zjPIgnec6B1pLhwO-ZbqMb6nvaq58mtEXh9fFeeL3zOQ%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSB6EDrciIFgOnxO27GwTKwnsaN8RIUflBL7Gthm4cbOT1MFBF_OnHbegnViMC2QwS3JAcfqlg66zqWcC4DdNcIRB2TUREGI51OKNRty_iyWYLfwOAt_LutSNejrgUOU3zzHrPsn5f7vCMUrnqIOsGTI%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=0f57d21b88b24b83a30e0fff4853d114&_e=zCxBadu8s7o2MNjRrXd_yEYVbI68a7k39kzC-giyEqb3o87xVCfVJ-Ho07Ziv7WqhBLTmVstkOmnjeokvuZoMxs0uPo1IpGJPXH-x1GIi_QQBCyZQSSoi65RPs1I2mSgyWLSu2BPz-e2XJbf7cuIL2Dyw1wWttlOjYvN3hvKZtj5xw1mBO_7EFXDyUlDD2VsME_ipxEqNlmX-oX7ivgrTLTuZ3DUQ6TIzolYvEMXRu4c-4r3o4QSw8JyE7AQBS1iP8qtKFh3pG_my2ZWPh3CSDaCBfc_5KtE_LoQzeBlmiYGDaxoqO6ylzjJ__qFzmxzyWz5QIUh6eoBRV1Y0rcq-y6uC1W9j7MMyCvO49ADvqXhpgSyup5aFJGjitin7VPMNH6RnseHRzyX58ekRmyT0cyy9Ry_Bgc6TfE1-Va9FGo%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden and Kamala Harris could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
As you may know, Vice President Kamala Harris is in Houston right now for a rally today, where she will talk about Texas’ extreme abortion laws and the devastating effects on Texans. Coming to our state this close to Election Day is a very big deal.
Texas Legends Willie Nelson and Native Houstonian Beyoncé will be there, too! They know, as we do, how important it is for Texans to vote this year with so much at stake and such an incredible opportunity to change things with our votes.
There is so much happening in HTown—and it is a reminder there is so much work to do! One in five votes in Texas is cast in Harris County. The work we do here matters. And our team is doing the work.
Tomorrow, I will join my good friend Colin Allred for a block walk to get out the vote. If you can join us, sign up here to come knock doors. To win in November we need to speak with voters all across Texas—we can't do it without your help! [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/735674/]

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102524_1&amount=25]
Folks -- we'll be blunt: Our fundraising is falling behind what we need for our GOTV operations .
This election is going to come down to who turns out their voters , and the reality is that the future of voting rights, abortion, and more are still in the balance with days left to go.
Opponents of voting rights have long worked behind the scenes to make it more difficult to vote . The MAGA movement is pushing hard to bring back the bad old days with limited early voting, reduced voting hours, more restrictions on mail-in ballots, and anything else they can ram through if they take control.
The vote suppressors have spent years honing their playbook for important states and elections. They have the advantage over us in both money and time.
That's why we need your help to fuel GOTV efforts for early voting, mail-in balloting, and on Election Day on November 5th. We're projecting a need to raise $25,000 for our Voter Mobilization Fund immediately .

And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book, ****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

The cryptocurrency AKA crypto lobby is rapidly becoming one of the largest
spenders in U.S. elections, making up HALF of all corporate political
donations this cycle, Peter. Let
us explain why that’s a problem...

The crypto industry has always just been Wall Street with a new name.
Plagued by corporate greed and corruption since the start, just like Wall
Street billionaires, it's willing to spend as much money as possible to
avoid being regulated and held accountable by Congress.

Like AIPAC, crypto wants to flood our elections with dark money and buy
off candidates who will put the interests and profits of billionaires
before the well-being and needs of the people, shaping policy and
legislation in their favor for years to come.

It’s bad enough that right-wing billionaire-backed lobbies like AIPAC have
such a grip on our political system — we witnessed them spend more than
ever before to defeat progressive champions Rep. Jamaal Bowman and Cori
Bush in the 2024 primaries. We can’t let crypto just mimic AIPAC's
playbook corrupting our democracy.

The solution? We need to combat the tens of millions of dollars from
corporate executives and crypto companies with grassroots donations from
everyday people like you, and use those resources to recruit and elect
progressive congressional candidates committed to fighting for us and
standing up to the billionaire class.

| | Hi Peter, We have 11 days until Election Day — and it’s been your incredible grassroots support that has helped our campaign keep up with my opponent’s out-of-state money. [**We can’t risk falling behind. Can you chip in a little ahead of our last end-of-month fundraising deadline in six days?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95819839/507981196/1131851138?refcode=X_102524_ParkRanger_act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzc2N2Q4ZC0wMDkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n1pfuMMPz9AC7rLFnShJvnOPRMYumwr-PrlH5U2JzOs=) I’ve had a lot of different jobs — and much of my career has been focused on protecting the environment. But looking back, one stands out as a favorite. Before I ran for Congress, before I served in the Arizona legislature, before I taught at the U of A (Go Cats!), before I worked as an environmental lawyer cleaning up contaminated waste sites and holding corporate polluters accountable — I worked as a National Park Ranger.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95819840/507981197/1131851138?refcode=X_102524_ParkRanger_act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzc2N2Q4ZC0wMDkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n1pfuMMPz9AC7rLFnShJvnOPRMYumwr-PrlH5U2JzOs=)

Our national parks are essential sanctuaries for local wildlife and ecosystems. They preserve some of the country's most beautiful places. And they’re the best kind of classroom for learning about conservation in the natural world. But protecting our environment goes beyond those public lands. **It means cleaning up pollution in our neighborhoods, protecting our water future, and investing in clean energy that lowers costs and brings good jobs to our state. ** With the Supreme Court gutting the EPA’s ability to enforce environmental regulations, it’s more important than ever to have voices in Congress fighting for clean air, clean water, and public lands. **That’s exactly what I’ll do. ** My opponent, on the other hand, has voted against clean energy jobs and accepted checks from Big Oil. [**Peter, this is our biggest and final fundraising deadline. We need your help to hit our goal. Can you chip in just a little now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95819841/507981198/1131851138?refcode=X_102524_ParkRanger_act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjcwOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzc2N2Q4ZC0wMDkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=n1pfuMMPz9AC7rLFnShJvnOPRMYumwr-PrlH5U2JzOs=)

But looking back, one stands out as a favorite. Before I ran for Congress, before I served in the Arizona legislature, before I taught at the U of A (Go Cats!), before I worked as an environmental lawyer cleaning up contaminated waste sites and holding corporate polluters accountable — I worked as a National Park Ranger. = Our national parks are essential sanctuaries for local wildlife and ecosystems. They preserve some of the country's most beautiful places. And they’re the best kind of classroom for learning about conservation in the natural world. But protecting our environment goes beyond those public lands. It means cleaning up pollution in our neighborhoods, protecting our water future, and investing in clean energy that lowers costs and brings good jobs to our state. With the Supreme Court gutting the EPA’s ability to enforce environmental regulations, it’s more important than ever to have voices in Congress fighting for clean air, clean water, and public lands. | | Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**.

I know, I know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

**Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by clicking on this secure link:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b1c63e877e9a4339b07a8a280fbac299&_e=yJZnDFYzA0MykB9HIHH2AO2_yH2142c4mKfhi1oNZ-UR1uGTfjL8xXHr38B6NFyfh4l5_jFm4LabEC89l94QGuExShcU0vq0jmwOs-K2mAv0DM5ybd-T_DaM_65sxnkaf6FDLB_Drllgc6CkFQ0X7a9DZa2c2kupzNzpMcAy4q7gLtu9Pf9jzAxJlBSqcQXUpC2X8OO6ekYkKirYMmzv4nLjzJMG5dJt0-SgHXbPt_JwEB5vXVMZWniitDqmaSIPn0DKpJEcl-Lai1knB8M5Z8aUhTXKTapXKg7SAZuESMwUJhjHLs9OjdYb4s6z-vGnsRk6YmAa9lSlEFTRVdK5oRt8jwtoLa3sL947McpkbfN154Rhv1SWv9vguy1WKVU-PM29zoHRP8SihEwOKXOKmg%3D%3D)

As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely **unaccountable** to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools...

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education--especially at taxpayer-funded state universities--bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission...

...to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

**Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to ...**
* **Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale 's _free_ online courses**, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism."

* **Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution** to citizens nationwide--especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

* **Provide an American classical education** to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

* **Expand the circulation of _Imprimis_** , Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar** so that when you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY--to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , and restore excellence to K-12 education.

**Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150 --or the best gift you can--by clicking the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b1c63e877e9a4339b07a8a280fbac299&_e=yJZnDFYzA0MykB9HIHH2AO2_yH2142c4mKfhi1oNZ-UR1uGTfjL8xXHr38B6NFyfh4l5_jFm4LabEC89l94QGuExShcU0vq0jmwOs-K2mAv0DM5ybd-T_DaM_65sxnkaf6FDLB_Drllgc6CkFQ0X7a9DZa2c2kupzNzpMcAy4q7gLtu9Pf9jzAxJlBSqcQXUpC2X8OO6ekYkKirYMmzv4nLjzJMG5dJt0-SgHXbPt_L0jsPctz3h1nh1HAX_nOWUVHRnxJGNNkk18gxvpQnhDla0lEmdZUSnOfB6TaimoctMjW8wggUgda3xWnXr1bjupjrDVet4JtEbmyxctn4ygbMfIXUAF7oFKB3-wztq78lUPtjhuNDAW4npu8TP-wL_jt7DC8LwQk393W-NcilcgQ%3D%3D)

And when you do, you'll claim your **2025 Hillsdale College calendar**. But you must act before October 31.

Thank you for being a steadfast Hillsdale supporter. Your generosity is needed now more than ever.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. **Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/2025calendar**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b1c63e877e9a4339b07a8a280fbac299&_e=yJZnDFYzA0MykB9HIHH2AO2_yH2142c4mKfhi1oNZ-UR1uGTfjL8xXHr38B6NFyfh4l5_jFm4LabEC89l94QGuExShcU0vq0jmwOs-K2mAv0DM5ybd-T_DaM_65sxnkaf6FDLB_Drllgc6CkFQ0X7a9DZa2c2kupzNzpMcAy4q7gLtu9Pf9jzAxJlBSqcQXUpC2X8OO6ekYkKirYMmzv4nLjzJMG5dJt0-SgHXbPt_I-SGIGJryQ1rTXoa-sidydi_OKTauoJIqJfy--IUiIaiA8HyhTfDhUXqUdwi6uWfU3uF189cV5-erDYgJS65hNkF7KcLysJhhQQpYMZyB4XPLzJy2EWmVlLFNxp-PV5ydqYCz5YMJ1eucukVa07nfOBFvlkuchhTrWi40bd9k00A%3D%3D)

When you do, you will defend liberty and help us accomplish our mission year after year. **Everything we accomplish is only possible due to your continued generosity, so thank you for your support of our mission!**

subject: A woman's place? In the House, Senate, and oval office
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Women make up more than 50% of the electorate, yet we hold only 27% of seats in Congress.
But with your help, that’s about to change.
When we defeat Jim Jordan, I’ll be the first woman to represent Ohio’s 4th District – and that’s just the beginning.
Will you rush a contribution today of $25, $50, or even $100 today to help us make history? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_a_womens_place_link1]
Let’s get something straight: A woman’s place is in the House, the Senate, and the Oval Office.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_a_womens_place_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_a_womens_place_image]
That’s what I’m fighting for here in Ohio, and that’s what Kamala Harris is going to do as President.
Together, we’re going to rid this nation of the scourge of the ULTRA-MAGA movement and these women-hating politicians who think they can strip away our rights.
Jim Jordan and his extremist friends have spent 17 years doing NOTHING for Americans.
They push bills like the SAVE Act, which would make it almost impossible for married women to vote.
They want to drag us back to a time when women barely had any rights at all.
Well, not on our watch.
Here’s the truth: Women are leading the way forward.
We’ve seen it in movements, in elections, and in our communities.
We’re not waiting for permission anymore. We are demanding a seat at every table and making sure our voices are heard in the halls of power.
The time for change is now, and I know that with our leadership, we can build a future where our daughters grow up knowing that no door is closed to them, no opportunity is out of reach.
I’m running to make sure our rights are expanded, our reproductive freedoms are protected, our schools are fully funded, and our economy works for everyone – not just corporate interests.
And Kamala Harris is going to help lead the charge to make sure we finally have leadership that reflects the strength that women bring and the diversity of our country.
It’s time to send Jim Jordan packing and show the world that Washington is ready for real leadership.
This is the most important congressional race in the country. We’ve got Jordan running scared, but we need your help to close the gap and hit our $3M goal. Will you contribute today and help us make history together? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_a_womens_place_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

I’ll jump right to it: For months, we’ve been building up a community-powered movement to defend the work we’ve made in Congress and continue to propel CA-25 toward a future of progress. And with what’s on the line, there’s truly no other option for us. **_Reproductive rights._** **_Social Security and Medicare._** **_The future of our democracy as we know it._** But we have a problem: **Since Donald Trump’s visit to our district, national MAGA donors have flooded thousands of dollars into CA-25 to attack our movement and all that we stand for.** To say the least, victory on November 5th is FAR from guaranteed. We’ve got to fight tooth and nail to ensure our district doesn’t fall into the hands of a MAGA extremist determined to undermine our fundamental freedoms and undo all of the progress we’ve made — and I need your help to do it. subject: A difficult decision:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the DSCC | PO Box 96047, Washington, DC 20090 | **[dscc
body:
| | | We made a very difficult decision last week.

We had a Team Slotkin meeting where it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could make a real play for additional votes as voting was underway across the state.

The money wasn't in the budget. But I gave the green light.

It's a risk. But this is the moment to take some risks. I've had similar moments in prior years. We can't get caught short when people are already casting their ballots in this election. That'd be a mistake.

But the bet we made was that, as the race tightens, and if we asked, our supporters would come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will. To keep the Senate in the hands of the Democrats.

**[So with that in mind: can you make a $5 contribution to the DSCC and my campaign to help us fill the budget gap, win this race, and defend the Senate? $5 isn't much, but at this point it's the small-dollar donations that are making a difference here at the end.](https://go.dscc.org/go/18871?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20241025-ElissaSlotkin-SlotkinBudgetGap-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20241025-ElissaSlotkin-SlotkinBudgetGap-Pros-sl1&akid=18591%2E9716520%2ExKdJSS)**

Like I said, it was a tough call. But if there's one thing that distinguishes this campaign, it's our people. You answer the call every single time. $5 is all we need to close the gap.

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Harris-Walz Interfaith Call Sun Oct. 27 7-8 pm ET
body:
All Faith Leaders Invited | |
---
| | | All clergy, leaders, and organizers are invited to the Faith for Harris-Walz interfaith **[Souls to the Polls Strategy call this Sunday October 27 from 7 – 8 pm ET](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=82dabd4316&e=43463f1dee)**.

Join other faith leaders for a virtual rally and message from special guests. **Please [register here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=aaf2b959db&e=43463f1dee).**

Vice President Harris is speaking at multiple houses of worship every weekend. Last weekend in Georgia she joined services at New Birth Baptist Ministry and at Divine Faith Ministries International. Governor Walz, a devout Lutheran, recently stopped in at Victorious Believers Ministries in Saginaw, Michigan. Both will be at services in the coming days as they share more about their commitment to the common good with other faithful Americans.

This call on [Sunday October 27 from 7-8 pm ET](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=d3f65b4f90&e=43463f1dee) will be an opportunity to join with other faith leaders to bring the Harris-Walz message to your congregations and community. You can also **share this [powerful video message from Vice President Harris](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=43bfa2c14f&e=43463f1dee) during services, prayer breakfasts, social gatherings, broadcasts, and on social media to help spread Harris' positive message.**

Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

We have at least 6 seats in-play here in California -- more than enough to flip the House majority. Right now, we are implementing a massive GOTV and ballot-chasing effort across these battlegrounds. But are short of funds for the final week. As Chair of the delegation, I have taken on the responsibility to raise these funds -- and I hope you can help. Anything you can do will be immediately spent on our CA red2blue races. Here is the link if you can help: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tbthzoe24?amount=10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tbthzoe24?amount=10]

I know we are all anxious for this election to be over. I am cautiously optimistic that Kamala will win if we all do what we need to do in this final sprint. But we know she needs a Democratic House to get her agenda passed. I hope you'll lend whatever support you can to that end.

| | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. clean_body: Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.| | | It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. | | | | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner. We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show our strength this month. So, please: The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, Ret.
subject: This is a time for political courage, and I need your help, Peter.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
Join me in calling upon Generals Mattis, Milley, and any other leaders who have served in close proximity to Trump to speak out, in public, directly to the American people. There is no time to waste.
#
Peter, Paul Eaton here. Retired Major General, U.S. Army, now with VoteVets.
In my estimation, we have one opportunity to break the hold that Donald Trump still has on millions of Americans; on Active Duty members of the Military, Veterans, members of Military Families, and more.
I believe that we need leaders of political courage to speak out in order to do it.
What I mean by that is the political courage shown by former Congresswoman Liz Cheney, who stood up to her own party in the face of Trump’s lawlessness and dictatorial aims.
The courage shown by General Kelly, Trump’s former Chief of Staff, who went forward publicly with his deep concerns about Trump — his belief that Trump meets the definition of a fascist, Trump’s fascination with and admiration of Hitler, Trump’s desire to be served by generals with absolute loyalty “like Hitler’s Generals,” and his continuous attacks on the dignity of the fallen, the wounded, the captured, and all who serve.
**Now is the time for Generals Milley, Mattis, and so many others who served under Trump to speak directly to the American people. Now is the time to say publicly what they have been reported as saying in private.**
Each of them swore the same oath I did: To support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It is their duty to speak out now.
Donald Trump is a grave domestic threat to our Constitution, and we desperately need leaders of character, conscience, and courage to do whatever they can to ensure he does not become our Commander in Chief once more.
**[Join me in calling upon Generals Mattis, Milley, and any other leaders who have served in close proximity to Trump to speak out, in public, directly to the American people. There is no time to waste.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/241024_vv_em_milley_mattis/?source=em241025-1-30?refcode2=33453.3013755.7u3HX_&akid=33453%2E3013755%2E7u3HX_)**

---

Very Respectfully,
Paul Eaton

Major General, U.S. Army, Retired

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Join us Tomorrow to Get Out The Vote in Indianapolis!
