During the rally, free yard signs will be available so you can help spread Democratic energy, beginning right in your front yard. Featured speakers for the event include Harris campaign surrogate and U.S. Congressman André Carson along with our statewide ticket! After Democratic Gubernatorial candidate Jennifer McCormick’s decisive victory in last night’s third and final debate of this election cycle, we need everyone to be committed to keeping this massive blue wave flowing. We can’t wait to see you Saturday and again at the polls! ** **Banks Still a No Show a Week and a Half From Election Day Bashful Banks is continuing to cower despite the election being less than two weeks away. He has not been present for a single debate, has never met his competitors, and rarely grants interviews or is present for events. Banks’ refusal to voice his policy positions and his avoidance of public appearances is a disservice to Hoosiers, who should know what the choices are before they step up to the ballot box. By running a silent race, Banks is taking advantage of his wealth, demonstrating his lack of dedication to the job itself. Meanwhile, Democratic candidate has led an incredibly vocal campaign, noting her support for abortion, affordable housing, sustainable wages, unions, early childhood education, and more. She is knowledgeable, energized, and prepared to give the role of U.S. Senator the respect it deserves. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Laura Kelly in an effort to garner more support. "I'm coming here because I think in [Indiana and New Hampshire], we have excellent candidates with excellent chances of getting across the finish line," Kelly said in an article published by the The visit highlights the hope the national organization has for McCormick, who, if elected, will be the first Democratic governor in Indiana in over two decades. **** Stephanie Yocum is running to represent all Hoosiers working, playing, and living in Indiana’s 88th District. She is a lifelong Hoosier, an AmeriCorps member, Vice President of a nonprofit, wife, and mother. She’s unburdened by what’s she’s done and will do

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, Have you seen Kamala’s eye-opening Town Hall with Anderson Cooper? She was asked about Gaza, and what she has to say to those who are refusing to vote for her because of her unwavering support for Israel’s brutal genocide that’s now in its second year. Her answer made clear that she just wants to be unburdened by what has been going on under her administration’s watch. While coldly acknowledging that people have “strong feelings” about viewing the images of innocents being massacred by U.S. supplied bombs in the first genocide that’s ever been livestreamed to the world, she quickly pivoted to other issues that she believes people “concerned” about “this issue” also care about – oddly leading with “the price of groceries” when it was under the Biden-Harris administration that the cost of feeding ourselves and our families skyrocketed out of control. Earlier this week, a Muslim American community organizer in Detroit, Michigan, Dr. Ahmed Ghanim, was forced under threat of arrest to leave an invitation-only event featuring Kamala and her constant campaign companion, Liz Cheney. This exemplifies her “outreach” to those who are demanding an end to the carnage that began in Gaza and is now spreading across the larger region of the Middle East. At every turn, Kamala has dismissed and insulted the Muslim and Arab American community. Since she was coronated as the anti-Democratic Party’s nominee last July, she’s left no doubt that among the many things that won’t fundamentally change under her administration, a blank-check for the Netanyahu regime to continue their horrific war crimes is on the top of the list. [_**Peter, as we approach the finish line for this historic campaign for people, planet and peace we need to let voters everywhere know that if they consider genocide a red line, they have a choice to vote their humanity with Stein/Ware. Can you give $2.40, $24.00 or more today to make sure that we can amplify Jill and Butch’s campaign with ads and digital billboards to put them on the radar for millions of Americans?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_25_pm&n=1)

* Kept criminals, who sought appeals, behind bars.
* First non-border state Attorney General to sue Biden/Harris over their open border policies.
* Safeguarded Indiana women’s sports from unfair male competition.
* Successfully defended Indiana’s pro-life law.
* Won over 90% of all jury trials defending Indiana’s interests.
* Created a Parents’ Bill of Rights.
* Returned record $81 million+ in unclaimed property-in one year.
* Published a Gun Owners’ Bill of Rights.
* Sued Google and got $700 million for violating our privacy.
* Recovered millions of our tax dollars from welfare theft and fraud.

| | , It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP** Christopher.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18894/6374453/1282741483be76409e8c5d7095cec66d2257ff0c/4bcb0c789218648beb3a29dde24a51b90ddff8d5). You don’t even have to leave your house to do it!**

This loophole ensures you encounter: Zero government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)... Zero lines, classroom time or books to read... Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit). **[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18894/6374453/1282741483be76409e8c5d7095cec66d2257ff0c/4bcb0c789218648beb3a29dde24a51b90ddff8d5).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18894/6374453/1282741483be76409e8c5d7095cec66d2257ff0c/4bcb0c789218648beb3a29dde24a51b90ddff8d5)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

| Peter, I understand that organizers don’t have unlimited resources. I understand that sometimes, we have to make tough calls. I understand that big dreams take time to achieve.

But I will never understand how anyone could look me in the eyes and tell me that my home state – and everyone living there – isn’t “worth” fighting for.

Still, every day, people try to claim that Florida is too red, too far gone, too deep under the thumb of the far-right fascists like Ron DeSantis, and that we can’t “afford” to fight back.

**If I’d listened to that kind of defeatism in 2022, I wouldn’t be writing to you today as the first Gen Z member of Congress. And I’m damn sure not listening to it now.**

[**_It takes real work to win tough fights. But it’s work we _know_ how to do, and I believe we can do it. Thanks to people like you, chipping in spare change and sometimes digging even deeper, we’re gaining serious ground in Florida. **This state is in play, and you won’t catch me on the sidelines when everything from our education to our democracy to our planet’s survival is at stake.**

Friend, Wearing riot gear and pointing guns at residents, University of Pennsylvania **police raided the off-campus home of pro-Palestine student activists this week**. Nonprofit organization Palestine Legal has condemned this alarming use of force as well as this fall semester’s wave of new anti-protest policies at colleges nationwide. In states such as Michigan, students and faculty have been hospitalized after brutal beatings and arrests—all for engaging in constitutionally protected activities. Our state’s Attorney General even filed criminal charges against peaceful student protesters. Palestine Legal writes: _“Activists and community members have been doxxed, threatened, investigated, censored, questioned, fired, and even assaulted simply because of their views.”_ For 12 years, Palestine Legal has been protecting our right to dissent by representing, advising, and providing legal education to activists and communities who speak out for Palestinian freedom. **Since last October, Palestine Legal has received almost 3,000 requests for legal support—more than 10x what the group receives in a typical year.** During this exponential increase of repression, Palestine Legal is supporting people who’ve experienced workplace discrimination and termination for expressing support for Palestinians’ human rights, as well as students and faculty at high schools and colleges across the country who are navigating censorship, suspensions, expulsions, evictions, police violence, and more. Thanks to Palestine Legal’s work, five universities are now under federal investigation for anti-Palestinian racism, and many schools have dropped charges and complaints against pro-Palestine students and professors. [**Please donate today to Palestine Legal, the only legal organization that’s committed to defending the civil and constitutional rights of people in the U.S. who speak out for Palestinian freedom. Progressive change happens because strong social movements demand it. For example, people forced the passage of civil rights legislation by marching, boycotting, leading civil disobedience, bringing cases before the Supreme Court, and relentlessly fighting for clear policy demands until they were passed by Congress and signed into law by the president.
**Our right to free speech and protest is a crucial part of making the transformative changes we need.** As Palestine Legal wrote: _“Student speech and organizing has always had a cherished and critical role in U.S. movements for racial and social justice, moving the needle on critical domestic and global issues.”_
Heartbreakingly, our movement has not yet ended the genocide or the occupation of Palestine. However, we are seeing a historic shift in U.S. public opinion on Palestine, with a majority of Americans in favor of stopping U.S. military aid to Israel. And we get closer to winning by using every tool we can, including pushing back through the courts with legal advocacy.
[**Will you chip in today to support Palestine Legal, the only legal organization in the United States exclusively dedicated to supporting the movement for Palestinian rights? Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book, ****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9f7f3c2717b64936bbc90013b2edfe2d&_e=cbAoKUBdrV1rtAL09lCn-_4i2JqErmzfo3zofElXPiwjdrLdISvbMFekdpnGiE8OqsKW0niRDhREMsWG5DKBCqe6Dl6nCnhO78M-xqXbvXtZFvnROs7jkx7DP_jeOXXiialRBczdr6vdMKhhTbznUsFpRyJgj-ASu7A1fCD7poP7-zSe2jrMqdMkXDXk16agbkNwjEb__t-KQ3UtvuQEQ0A1kSoBco7NwrA8r1hWvzBViljYcOh42ZkPknyc-NjQt59wzfh0Z5krMDu2goi8uiqDKZvlFXLW4cZ0hqeRTK4DWJNg0xeqJCASixwt5r3m)_

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

Two things you should know about the Arizona State Supreme Court race:
1. **Two extreme judges who helped uphold an abortion ban from the Civil War era are up for re-election this year.**
2. A ballot initiative that would end term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges is up for a vote as well. If passed, **the Arizona ballot initiative would essentially cancel future elections for these court seats.** On top of that, the ballot initiative would be retroactive — meaning these two justices would retain their seats even if they lose in November.

These state supreme court races typically fly under the radar — and Arizona is just one example of how consequential they can be. That’s why the NDRC is working across the country to elect fair-minded justices who will defend democracy and protect our freedoms. Republicans are trying to lock in a deeply conservative state supreme court. Proposition 137 would get rid of term limits for high-level state judges and end retention elections — meaning, if it passes, it would take away the vote from the people _retroactively_. That means **even if Arizona voters unseat these judges in November, their voices will be null and void if the ballot initiative passes. **
By the end of last month, conservative groups raised nearly half a _million_ dollars to support these state supreme court justices — who were selected by former Republican governor Doug Ducey _after_ he upped the court from five to seven justices.
It’s plain as day what’s going on here: **the GOP wants to pack the courts with radical judges and then take away the people’s right to object. **

Third District, Kelly Morrison: I’ve worked across the aisle to get things done
In Congress, I’ll focus on protecting reproductive rights, living costs, health care, public safety, and more.
By Kelly Morrison
I’ve spent most of my career as a doctor – not a politician. I’m an OB-GYN who has been practicing in Minnesota for over 20 years, and I’ve dedicated my life to helping people. If elected to represent the Third District, I would be the only pro-choice OB-GYN in Congress. At a time when reproductive rights are under attack across our country, Washington needs voices who will make sure that women – not politicians – can make their own health care decisions. But that’s not the only reason I’m running for Congress.
I first ran for office in 2018 because I was concerned about the future of our state and I knew we needed voices of reason in our government who were focused on delivering results. As a Democrat who grew up in a Republican family, I know that good ideas can come from both sides of the aisle. So during my time in the Minnesota legislature, I worked with both Republicans and Democrats to pass more than 90 bills, many with bipartisan support. I passed legislation to extend health insurance for new moms and their babies from just 60 days to 12 months, and increased mental health access for Minnesotans by allowing psychologists to practice across state lines – and I worked across the aisle to get it done.
Now I want to take this common-sense, results-oriented approach to Washington. First, I’m focused on lowering costs for Minnesota families. We need to take on the high cost of housing and increase the supply of housing at all income levels, and make child care more affordable for families.
And as a doctor, I know what it’s like to see my patients struggle to afford the medication they need, so when I got to the Minnesota legislature I took on Big Pharma and passed legislation to help lower prescription drug costs in our state. But we need to do more, especially on the federal level. That means extending the $35 cap on insulin and the $2,000 annual cap on prescription drugs that was put in place for seniors to all Americans, and it means allowing Medicare to negotiate lower prices for more prescription drugs.
I believe everyone deserves to feel safe in their communities. We need to make sure our law enforcement officers have the resources they need to do their jobs well – that’s why I supported legislation providing $300 million in aid to local law enforcement, including police, fire and 911 departments, and I co-authored legislation to crack down on violent carjackings. We also need to take on gun violence, which is now the number one killer of children in America. I helped pass universal background checks and extreme risk protection orders in Minnesota, and now we need to take this issue on in Washington.
As the wife of an Army combat veteran, I know how important it is to ensure that our veterans have the resources and support they need. I was proud to pass legislation that provides 9/11 veterans and their families with service bonuses, and I will continue to advocate on behalf of veterans in Congress.
And as a mom of three, I’m focused on keeping our kids safe and building a better future for them. That means tackling the opioid crisis, taking on the social media companies that are hurting our children, fighting climate change, and protecting our lakes and rivers for generations to come.
Finally, I want to go to Congress to be a bridge-builder. If you look at what’s happening in Congress right now, it’s a broken institution. We have to send people to Washington who believe in the promise of America and who want to make government work. That is my mission, and I invite everyone – Democrats, Republicans, and Independents alike – to join me on this journey.

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: You definitely know this person.
body:
They are a Democrat, or they dislike Trump greatly ... maybe they're a friend, a relative...
---
$3. That is the donation we're asking you to make to the Democratic Party today -- money we will use to turn out Democrats who don't vote in every election, and may not vote in this one without our help. You probably know who we're talking about. They are a Democrat, or they dislike Trump greatly. Maybe they're a friend, a relative, someone you see pop up on your social media feed posting about the election... but they are not someone who can be counted on to vote. While it might not seem like $3 could make a huge difference at this point, we hope you’ll keep in mind that a LOT of the donations we use to help fund our voter outreach efforts come from people like you donating a few bucks at a time, often in response to emails like this. There are thousands and thousands of people like that in every battleground state. We know who they are! Friend,
I have dedicated my life to fighting for justice and equity; fighting for folks without a voice.
While it’s always been worth it, I’d be lying if I said it’s been easy – especially now that I’m running for Congress. The unfortunate and very real truth is that Black women candidates raise only half of what their male counterparts do, and a third of white women candidates.
As we speak, right-wing extremists are targeting my campaign. They don’t see a Black woman, who is committed to justice and delivering real results for the Bay Area. They see a candidate who stands as a formidable force against their regressive agenda.

Folks — Donald Trump is scrambling to take back his extreme stance on abortion. In a desperate attempt to appeal to women voters, he even called himself the “father of IVF” at a recent town hall. But let’s not forget: it was Trump who bragged about overturning _Roe_. **_He is the reason 1 in 3 women live in states where abortion is banned_****,** and lives are at risk because reproductive freedoms were stripped away. Right now, abortion is on the ballot, and people across Arizona are already voting on this. But there are still many voters who haven’t cast their ballots yet, and we need to reach them. body:
And Alexandria is different, too.
#
Can we be real with you for a moment?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves. That’s okay. Real people wrote this email, we get them as well. We understand how people can get frustrated. _But let us explain why this is vital._
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, you will. That’s how this transformative movement works.**It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
[We’re just 11 days away from the election, and we’re hoping to hit our fundraising targets before then. The only way we can is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. If you can, will you make a $3 contribution — or $5, or anything you can — right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241025.j1mjr_&refcode=em20241025-7454-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7454%2E2526796%2EZeOuVT)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241025.j1mjr_&refcode=em20241025-7454-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=7454%2E2526796%2EZeOuVT)**
We’re not exaggerating: most members of Congress fuel their reelection campaigns by dedicating hours of their time asking rich donors for $500, $1000, or even $3300 donations.
**Alexandria is different.** This whole movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a campaign that is...
1. Raising resources, recruiting volunteers, and making calls to help elect progressive allies across Congress, and build a progressive majority.
2. Reaching out to communities across NY-14 and the country to spread awareness about the Green New Deal, how to influence local, state, and federal leaders, and more.
3. Raising money for community relief organizations, closing critical resources gaps that the federal government has left unfilled.
4. Working day and night to reelect AOC, defeat our Republican opponents, and show the world what we can do.

[If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241025.j1mjr_&refcode=em20241025-7454-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=7454%2E2526796%2EZeOuVT)
Thanks for reading,
Team AOC

Team — I’m a little confused.

Last month this team came together and helped us put up an incredible day of fundraising. One of the best of the campaign.

It was awesome. It put some wind in my sails, honestly. Gave me hope.

But... since then we’ve had one of the worst fundraising stretches in months. No joke. People just aren’t chipping in, and that is a huge problem.

My team’s getting really worried. I’ve told them to take it day by day, but I promised I’d reach out and ask you — what happened?

Do people really think this race is all wrapped up? Cause I can tell you, personally, that it’s not. This state is going to be decided by less votes than it takes to fill a football stadium, and that is the truth. Arizona isn’t a blue state. Until very recently it was one of the reddest states in the country, and it could very easily go that way again.

But right now, we’re not pacing to our goals. We’re not pacing to stop Trump and Kari Lake from winning this November. And if we don’t pick things back up — FAST — we’re going to be in real trouble. WAR, CHAOS, AND CRISIS
The Only Path to Peace–
RFK Jr. and Trump!
Dear Peter,
With only days to go until the most important election of our lifetime, we are sounding the alarm. ...
_A vote for Kamala Harris is a vote for war._
Dick Cheney, the driving force behind the Iraq War that killed more than one million human beings, endorsed Kamala Harris. Why? Because she is beholden to the war machine that thrives on conflict and chaos, no matter the cost to American lives or global stability.
**Recent events paint a clear and alarming picture.** Israel is expected to hit military targets _inside Iran_ ; China’s President Xi is ordering his troops to prepare for war; North Korea’s dictator, Kim Jong-un, has blown up vital roads and railways, isolating his nation for whatever comes next; and there are reports NATO is considering arming Ukraine with nuclear weapons, bringing the threat of global conflict to our doorstep.
The world is on the brink, and Kamala is ready to drag us right into it.
Under Kamala’s leadership, the same failed policies of intervention and military expansion will continue. She stands with the defense contractors and corporate elites who profit from conflict while American families pay the price.
**But there is a path to peace—and it starts with electing President Trump and sending Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to DC.**
Together, they are the only ones willing to stand up to these entrenched interests and stop the Military-Industrial Complex from dragging us into devastating wars. RFK Jr. will bring a new voice to the administration, working alongside President Trump to dismantle the war machine that Kamala is ready to empower.
[**With war looming and only days left, we need your help to stop Kamala and her military-industrial backers.__The clock is ticking.__**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-war?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=war_10_25_24_1&n=5)

President Trump is the only candidate willing to stand up to these powerful forces and fight for peace. He will not bow to the war machine, and with RFK Jr. at his side, he will ensure that our country is not pulled into a catastrophic conflict.
**Time is running out. The future of peace is in your hands.**
Team Kennedy

Dick Cheney, the driving force behind the Iraq War that killed more than one million human beings, endorsed Kamala Harris. Why? The world is on the brink, and Kamala is ready to drag us right into it. Under Kamala’s leadership, the same failed policies of intervention and military expansion will continue. She stands with the defense contractors and corporate elites who profit from conflict while American families pay the price. But there is a path to peace—and it starts with electing President Trump and sending Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to DC. RFK Jr. will bring a new voice to the administration, working alongside President Trump to dismantle the war machine that Kamala is ready to empower. President Trump is the only candidate willing to stand up to these powerful forces and fight for peace. Friday, October 25, 2024 | Peter-- Here is your weekly **Forward Friends** volunteer update! Just over a week to go, what can you do? There's still plenty of time to text bank, and meet some more of our candidates this Wednesday at [Meet the Forwardists Part 2](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fTauy-itwlWmXjZxdHIXXR-11B7KZpevUULIwFXjp5Bo27ZZJbvL0K0zau9B_Qm21SoGrjaG4uwytXtKD0Id8UZ2-SsiiEANxJ8IKdVIiMc&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=2). _Last Week’s Highlights:_ A huge thank you to everyone who joined our Monday Night Madness and Black Voters Committee text banks this week. * _Monday Oct 28th_ [Monday Night Madness](meet.google.com/ssu-wudq-uxd) is happening again at 8pm ET.
* _Tuesday Oct 29th_ the **Veterans Committee** will hold a text bank event at 8pm ET.
* _Tuesday Oct 29th_ Florida is having a [statewide call](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=zP34ITG1tILbu7UqGsEZiDMo7AsUlIrSy2r6-aQ-qW8Uwk4DgPIK4EvDEX0t9lS0Jdjb8su5JMPiZEnafUKqdeFu_9Z5A69ud1dmeiXPzbA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=6) at 7pm ET with board member **Michael Willner.**
* _Wednesday Oct 30th_ join us for **Meet the Forwardists Part 2** at 8pm ET. We have a new round of candidates that **Gov Whitman** and**Lindsey** **Williams Drath** will introduce, you don't want to miss it! You can register [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fTauy-itwlWmXjZxdHIXXR-11B7KZpevUULIwFXjp5Bo27ZZJbvL0K0zau9B_Qm21SoGrjaG4uwytXtKD0Id8UZ2-SsiiEANxJ8IKdVIiMc&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=7)
* _Friday Nov 1st_ is our **Final Push Forward** with the text banking! [Join us](meet.google.com/etp-nmqg-cfw) at 12pm ET and help clear out any remaining texts!

Be sure to keep checking the [events page](https://home.forwardparty.com/public_calendar?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=8) for any last minute activities that may pop up. _State Spotlight:_ This week I want to pay special attention to the teams in [Utah](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=4h2u19b4cTAhgCD-RT-MfucisWAapKTztiYbrCzE4E2K3ySCiWhmx577ts548Hv2&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=9) and [Colorado](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wEbziwCnBibdhLYxt491cAt1C4T15LSjQkghBL3doJrKvgxM11riL_UYCgkhOr0C&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=10). They both have a whopping 17 candidates, with some running on the Forward party line. This was a massive undertaking to idenify, interview, and endorse this many exceptional candidates, and wouldn't have been acheived without the incredible efforts of our wonderful volunteers there. We do have a couple of these candidates up on our [CallHub](https://home.forwardparty.com/voter_outreach_text_phone_banking?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_5&n=11), quit reading this and go send some texts! In closing this week I just really want to express my gratitude to everyone for getting involved. When I look at everything being accomplished I am in awe of what a dedicated team can get done. Thank you so much and let's keep going! Carrie Anne Templeton

| | Peter, with only 11 days until Election Day our race is not slowing down.

**All across our district, we are door-knocking, attending events, and meeting new people!**
---
| | **This past week, we stopped by BLINK in Downtown Cincinnati! **

It was great seeing friends and connecting with voters!
---
|
---
| | **We also attended the Springboro Chamber Gala! I enjoyed spending the night with such outstanding business leaders and friends**

And a special congratulations to all of this year's awardees! Check out some photos below!

|

|
---
| | Peter, we are only 11 days away from Election Day and every little bit helps.

**$10, $20, $50, or $100 to our race, can be all the difference in achieving victory for our campaign. **

| | I have never been prouder of Georgia. Even as we face attempts to squeeze the people’s voices out of our democracy, the people of this state refuse to let our voices and our votes be silenced. Over 2 million Georgians have already voted in this election, and many more will do so before early voting ends November 1. With changes to our election rules coming down to the wire, voting early is our best bet to ensure record turnout in numbers too big to cry fraud. In 2020 and 2021, Fair Fight helped drive record-breaking voter turnout among Georgians, particularly young voters and voters of color — flipping the Peach State blue for the first time in decades. Cynics said it wasn’t possible, but together we proved them wrong. We have the power to do it again, and to make the promise of democracy real for us all. I was there, and I’ll never forget that feeling, knowing Georgia was taking a step into the future. We will not and can not let Donald Trump and his allies cut away at our democracy by blocking voters and disregarding our voices. We refuse to be silent when they undermine election certification. This year’s election is pivotal: it will determine whether we move forward as a nation or lose our democracy piece by piece. That’s why, from now until November 1, we must educate voters on their power and mobilize turnout. November 5 is the last day to vote, but we’ll work right up until the polls close. We can win this, Georgia — I know we can. Hey folks,

It’s Bart Starr Jr.—Yes, son of legendary Packers QB Bart Starr, Bart Jr. I grew up in Green Bay, WI and am an attorney, financial consultant, and a lifelong Republican.

I voted for both Bushes, Dole, McCain, & Romney.

**There exists in much of America a belief, one my Republican family accepted for decades, that GOP presidents are better for the U.S.** in terms of stock market performance, economic and job growth, and fiscal discipline/deficits.

_It turns out we were wildly mistaken._

Someone known to most Americans said, years ago, “It just seems the economy does better under the Democrats than the Republicans.” Before we identify him, let’s see if he was correct by analyzing long term data in order to avoid the distortion effects of one or two strange years.

From 1961 through 2024 (64 years), Republicans have held the presidency for 32 years, exactly the same number as Democrats (if we include 2024 as a full year). [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95833574/508026200/-1558312980?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_StarrSplit_241025_T1_2&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_starrsplit_241025_t1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMDRkN2RkOS0yNDkzLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MVFlmTW-CDrQ6yk9M53b8HqtA0qD5CwY83WkceE1bqk=) Let’s look at the stock market performance from 1961-2024.

Assume we invested $10,000 in the stock market and allowed growth to compound only during Republican presidencies; our $10,000 would have done well, growing to approximately $105,000 during those 32 years.

**If we did the exact same thing, but invested only during the 32 years of Democratic presidencies, we would have again done well...exceptionally well. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jim Jordan is a loyal footsoldier for Trump’s dictatorship
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Did you hear Trump’s latest chilling comment?
He said, "I need the kind of generals that Hitler had."
That’s right – Trump is openly admiring the loyalty Hitler’s generals showed, who followed his orders without question, no matter how horrific.
And do you know who’s been one of Trump’s most loyal foot soldiers in Congress?
Jim Jordan!
Jordan has spent 17 years doing nothing but serving himself and carrying Trump’s water by voting against our freedoms, and embracing conspiracy theories.
Trump’s admiration for dictators and his desire for unquestioning loyalty in people like Jim Jordan is terrifying.
And it’s a threat to our democracy.
We have to stop this, and we have to stop it now.
Can you chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to help us reach our $3M goal? Every dollar gets us closer to making sure Jim Jordan’s dangerous time in Congress comes to an end. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_trumps_generals_link1]
This is the same Jim Jordan who stood by Trump as he lied about the election being stolen.
The same Jim Jordan who supports extremist bills like the SAVE Act, which would take away the right to vote from married women.
This is who we’re up against – a man loyal to Trump’s authoritarian dreams, not to the people of Ohio or the American democracy.
Think about what Trump is saying here.
He doesn’t want generals or politicians loyal to the Constitution or the American people—he wants blind, Hitler-like loyalty.
It’s horrifying, and Jim Jordan is the perfect example of this kind of dangerous loyalty.
Jordan would rather protect Trump’s lies and conspiracies than fight for his own district. He already turned his back on the Constitution, who knows what else he would do. I cringe to think of who he would sell our top secret documents to.
This is the most important congressional race in the country, and it’s not just about flipping a seat. It’s about stopping the destruction of democracy at the hands of men like Trump and Jordan.
We’ve got 12 days left to win this.
Together, we can send this dangerous footsoldier packing and show the country that we’re not falling for Trump’s authoritarian playbook. Help us finish strong by contributing today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241025_trumps_generals_link2]
Let’s send Jim Jordan home for good.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
Nowhere is more important than PA.
Hi Peter, it's Jon Lovett. I love Pennsylvania.
It’s home to Philly, the city that dares to ask the question: do you want an enemy in Pennsylvania?
One thing I learned about myself by visiting the Commonwealth is that I don’t care how you treat me, as long as the sandwiches are good, and you’ve got the best sandwiches in the country. (Cry about it, Chicago.)
Pennsylvania is also home to Bob Casey, who’s facing a tough re-election.
The senior Senator is up against David McCormick, an out-of-towner rich guy (PA Republicans sure do have a type) who supports extreme abortion bans with no exceptions for rape or incest.
This guy could self-fund this race and has a bunch of right-wing money hanging over the race like a piano on a fraying string. Republicans could spend _hundreds of millions of dollars_ in PA to flip this seat red.
[**That’s why I’m doing one of these classic emails asking you to chip in a few dollars to support Senator Bob Casey’s re-election campaign, because we need to do everything we can to help him win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241025-6?refcode=em20241025-6&refcode2=4679_552475_YifXnE&akid=4679%2E552475%2EYifXnE)
We all know that Pennsylvania will be a top presidential battleground in 2024. It’s part of both Democrats’ and Republicans’ paths to victories.
**That puts an even bigger spotlight on this Senate race, where Mitch McConnell and national Republicans are all in for the mega-millionaire hedge fund exec (that’s McCormick, who I mentioned earlier).**
[**This is going to be a tough race, and we just can’t afford to lose this seat. Can you chip in to Bob’s campaign today? Every dollar counts!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241025-6?refcode=em20241025-6&refcode2=4679_552475_YifXnE&akid=4679%2E552475%2EYifXnE)

This race could determine the Senate majority. _We have to win._
Thanks for the sandwiches,
Jon Lovett

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Customers who don’t just go to McDonald’s for a photo-op may have noticed something recently.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
No, it’s not the return of the snack wrap.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2385%2E4032634%2Eh7HG48)
---
Customers who order at McDonald’s frequently — who don’t just go there for a photo-op — may have started to notice something different on the menu lately. No, it’s not the return of the snack wrap. It’s higher prices. Now, while McDonald’s is not the only fast food restaurant that has increased prices significantly, as the largest fast food chain in the United States, this has a particularly outsized impact on consumers. And we’ve heard the same “company who cried inflation” story as to why — McDonald’s USA President Joe Erlinger has attempted to blame the price increases on inflationary pressures and input costs. But the data tells another story. Since the COVID-19 pandemic, fast food prices have consistently outpaced inflation, and since 2020, overall inflation has increased by 20 percent, while McDonald’s has increased its menu prices for several items substantially more. McDonalds net annual income rose by over 79 percent — nearly $8.5 billion, from 2020 to 2023. While McDonald’s was raising prices, the company also spent nearly $4 billion on stock buybacks in 2022 and $3 billion in 2023. The company also benefits from a tax loophole that favors buybacks. This prioritizes Wall Street shareholders over investments in McDonald’s own business and workers. So Senators Casey, Wyden, and I called on McDonald’s President and CEO, Chris Kempczinski, to share more information on McDonald’s increased pricing decisions, and whether executives received bonuses or other incentive-based compensation from 2020 to 2024 based on their ability to increase per-customer profits. [**Fast food corporations are squeezing customers to make massive profits, paying out billions to wealthy shareholders, and then turning around and blaming inflation for high costs. It’s not right — and something must be done about this. Please add your name to say you’re with me in this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-fast-food-prices/?source=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&refcode=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&t=8&akid=2385%2E4032634%2Eh7HG48) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-fast-food-prices/?source=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&refcode=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&t=9&akid=2385%2E4032634%2Eh7HG48)
---
This is part of a major trend we’re seeing right now: Corporations are citing inflation this, inflation that, when it comes to defending their rising prices — all while their profits have surged over the past few years, outrunning inflation by miles.
Price gouging certainly isn’t a new trend. But during the COVID-19 pandemic, big corporations took advantage of the crisis to prey on consumers by price gouging, hiding behind inflation and supply chain disruptions to do it — and we’re still paying the price.
So I’ve fought back by reintroducing my Price Gouging Prevention Act, which would:
* Prohibit price gouging at the federal level — anytime and anywhere.
* Target dominant companies that have exploited the pandemic to boost profits — including companies that brag about increasing prices during periods of inflation.
* Require public companies to clearly disclose costs and pricing strategies at certain times.
* Provide additional funding to the FTC for enforcement.

[**I am frankly sick and tired of giant corporations seizing any opportunity to raise their prices and pad their profits on the backs of working people. Please add your name if you agree: Enough is enough.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-fast-food-prices/?source=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&refcode=EMZ23K_FIN_E_20241025_V1S1&t=10&akid=2385%2E4032634%2Eh7HG48)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

He's a fourth-generation Texan, a former civil rights lawyer, and a Congressman who's consistently put people above politics. But Colin just can't win this without extensive grassroots support. He's counting on your help to reach voters in every corner of Texas, fight back against Ted Cruz's onslaught of TV attack ads, and finally give Texans the Senator they deserve. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Friend -- Do my opponents know what time it is? Tonight the Sare Symposium will feature an exciting, first hand report from the BRICS conference, which just concluded on October 24th in Moscow. I will be joined tonight by Richard Black, the Schiller Institute representative at the UN. The goal of the BRICS is to end colonialism and establish a new paradigm of development among all nations. Why is such a goal considered a _causus belli_ by the West? Why is the significance of this BRICS conference in many ways on the same footing as the US presidential election itself? Who is promoting war -- including nuclear war -- rather than peace? Join us for this first hand report, and consider the questions and difficulties involved in establishing a new paradigm of peace through development. I also invite you to join this Saturday's Sare and the Jose Vega conference which will take place in New York City from 2 pm to 5. [Our conference is entitled](vegasarepeacefund.org): "Build A Peace Chorus Against the Ghouls of War"! We will be joined by a group of courageous people in discussion and music. Participants include: Jimmy Doar, Scott Ritter, Garland Nixon, Ray McGovern, Col. Larry Wilkinson, Keaton Weiss, Russ Dobular, and Helga Zepp LaRouche. My opponents are pathetically committed to the alternative policy of war. [See my response to the debate from which I was excluded on October 23rd.](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=XCQjXK2gfZavpXeHUbAHDFSuxDX_eH5njKgsjLHXssiStIWhnezVJXeMOEz5Rp_C6v6BMK_rfCI12zHUw3Xzdpva27vmpdq7ffjVExz0mqQddZ8GWZUUf9cej8Od05Uk&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20241025_symposium&n=2) Don't vote for the duopoly and corporate media platform of nuclear war and genocide. clean_body: | | Friend -- Do my opponents know what time it is? Tonight the Sare Symposium will feature an exciting, first hand report from the BRICS conference, which just concluded on October 24th in Moscow. I will be joined tonight by Richard Black, the Schiller Institute representative at the UN. The goal of the BRICS is to end colonialism and establish a new paradigm of development among all nations. Why is such a goal considered a causus belli by the West? Why is the significance of this BRICS conference in many ways on the same footing as the US presidential election itself? Who is promoting war -- including nuclear war -- rather than peace? Join us for this first hand report, and consider the questions and difficulties involved in establishing a new paradigm of peace through development. I also invite you to join this Saturday's Sare and the Jose Vega conference which will take place in New York City from 2 pm to 5. vegasarepeacefund.org: "Build A Peace Chorus Against the Ghouls of War"! We will be joined by a group of courageous people in discussion and music. Participants include: Jimmy Doar, Scott Ritter, Garland Nixon, Ray McGovern, Col. Larry Wilkinson, Keaton Weiss, Russ Dobular, and Helga Zepp LaRouche. My opponents are pathetically committed to the alternative policy of war. Don't vote for the duopoly and corporate media platform of nuclear war and genocide. Join Jose Vega and myself for a different conception of a beautiful humanity. \--Diane Sare * | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Sare for Senate

name: Erin Phillips, LCV Victory Fund
subject: URGENT FIELD UPDATE: Critical GOTV efforts in PA, MI, NC and more are in jeopardy with 10 days to go until Election Day.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by LCV Victory Fund,www
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE2OTIzMTMS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA4MDQyNDA4OQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter — I run LCV Victory Fund’s field organizing program and have some
urgent updates to share from our field teams as early voting is in full swing in
states across the country. The good news: our get-out-the-vote (GOTV) campaigns are making a difference.Our teams of over 2,000 canvassers are on the ground in Pennsylvania, Michigan,
Wisconsin, North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona. And they’re working nonstopto get pro-environment, pro-democracy voters in these key states to the polls
early or on Election Day. The bad news: we’re running out of time — and resources. There are still tens of thousands of voters we need to reach — and with only 10 days to go until Election Day, our GOTV efforts are still underfunded. There’s still time to make an impact in this election, Peter. Don’t
wait — a group of donors will 3X MATCH every gift to LCV Victory Fund up to our
$100,000 goal, tripling your impact on Election Day. This could be the most important election of our lifetime — we must act now. Rush a TRIPLE MATCHED gift to LCV Victory Fund to help bring our GOTV efforts over the finish line. Even $5 helps our campaigns >> https://links.messages.lcv. MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. LCV Victory Fund’s GOTV campaigns are already making a HUGE impact reaching
voters in key swing states. To date, our team has: Knocked on over 2.2 million doors. Talked to over 330,000 voters with the power to decide this election — 74% of whom are committed to voting for pro-environment, pro-democracy candidates.Helped thousands of voters make a voting plan to use their voice on Election Day. We have a plan to contact tens of thousands more voters in the next 10 days. But here’s the problem, Peter — we might fall short if we don’t hit our fundraising goal.We urgently need the support of grassroots environmentalists like you to turn
out ALL these voters and win in November. There are only a few days left until Election Day — and we’re locked in on
reaching our goal of getting as many pro-environment voters as possible to the polls. But we can’t reach our goal without your support. So, please, Peter, will you triple your impact with a 3X MATCHED gift today? Your contribution — even $5 — will make a difference in our campaign >> https://links.messages.lcv. I know I don’t need to tell you how important this election is, Peter. We must win. We can win. But only if we’re all in. Onward, Erin Phillips
National Field Director
